At quarter filling, the spin current exhibits a single enhancement peak, in contrast to the two-peak response observed at half filling. The Hubbard interaction affects the two half-filled peaks differently: it suppresses the primary peak, whereas the secondary peak exhibits a nonmonotonic, re-entrant response, with the current recovering at finite interaction strength. The interacting results are further characterized through the Drude weight, and comparisons with exact diagonalization (ED) and density-matrix renormalization group (DMRG) calculations for a finite half-filled system support the reliability of the MFT description. Our findings elucidate how quasiperiodic modulation, AFM order, band filling, and electronic correlations collectively govern the magnitude and spin-resolved character of persistent currents, giving rise to multiple enhancement regimes and interaction-induced re-entrant behavior.
summary:
1. 作者研究穿磁通的一维反铁磁准周期哈伯德环，以自洽哈特里–福克理论分析调制、填充和相互作用对持续电荷与自旋流的影响。
2. 半填充下特定参数区出现双增强峰且主导自旋切换，相互作用压低首峰却使次峰非单调恢复；四分之一填充的自旋流仅现单峰。
3. 结果提示可借准周期调制与关联调控持续流，但相互作用结论主要基于平均场，精确对角化和密度矩阵重整化群的支持限于有限半填充体系。

title: Edge-Plasmon-Induced Magnetization in Higher Chern Insulators
abstract: Higher Chern insulators host multiple dissipationless chiral edge states, one per unit of Chern number. We study the collective plasmon modes of these edge states at a domain wall between Chern numbers $\mathcal{C}$ and $-\mathcal{C}$, using a semiclassical model with Coulomb interactions. The plasmon dispersion is linear at long wavelengths, with a velocity that increases linearly with $\mathcal{C}$. As in conventional two-dimensional metals, the edge plasmon generates an elliptically polarized electric field that decays into the bulk and drives electrons in circular orbits, producing a static orbital magnetization (inverse Faraday effect). For topological edge plasmons, the magnetization has a nontrivial spatial profile set by two competing length scales: the finite extent of the edge states and the plasmon wavelength. At fixed edge-charge amplitude, it grows strongly with $\mathcal{C}$. At the domain wall, it approaches a finite plateau at low frequency and decays as $1/\omega^2$ at high frequency. Its temperature dependence is nonmonotonic, with a maximum at an intermediate temperature. These results show how the Chern number controls plasmon-induced magnetization, in contrast to conventional edge plasmons.
summary:
1. 作者用含库仑相互作用的半经典模型，研究陈数正负相反畴壁处多条手性边缘态的集体等离激元及其逆法拉第轨道磁化。
2. 长波模速度随陈数线性增加，固定边缘电荷振幅下磁化显著增强，其空间分布由边缘态宽度与波长竞争决定，畴壁磁化低频趋于平台、高频按频率平方反比衰减。
3. 该理论揭示了以陈数调控等离激元诱导磁化的可能性，并预言中间温度下磁化最大，但尚需实验检验。

title: Diffusion models for the $O(3)$ nonlinear sigma model
abstract: A score-based diffusion model is trained on the two-dimensional classical Heisenberg model, the lattice representation of the $O(3)$ nonlinear sigma model. Neural networks are trained on three different coarse-grainings of the same training set to implement a multiscale sampling scheme that modestly improves both the accuracy and computational cost of direct sampling on the finest lattice. Stein (or Schwinger-Dyson) diagnostics for the two-point correlation function are introduced to assess the quality of the learned score without relying on reverse diffusion sampling. These diagnostics are also incorporated into an additional training loss. We discuss several technical considerations relevant to implementing diffusion models on $S^2$. These include a consideration of lifting the network input to $S^3$, as in the $CP^1$ representation, and developing a boundary-layer approximation to the short-time spherical heat kernel that extends its usefulness to larger diffusion times.
summary:
1. 针对二维O(3)非线性西格玛模型的构型采样，作者在经典海森堡晶格上训练基于得分的扩散模型，以同一数据集的三种粗粒化实现多尺度采样。
2. 相较最细晶格直接采样，该方案小幅改善精度与计算成本，并引入无需反向扩散采样的两点关联函数Stein诊断以评估得分质量、补充训练损失。
3. 研究为球面扩散采样提供质量检验工具；所讨论的S³输入提升与球面热核边界层近似可供后续实现参考，但其整体采样收益尚未确立。

title: Fractal dimensions of paths on three-dimensional random-walk traces
abstract: We study four paths that join the starting site to the final position of a simple random walk of \(N=L^2\) steps on the infinite cubic lattice. The paths are selected on the walk trace---the graph of visited sites and traversed bonds---by different rules: the undirected shortest path \(S_1\), the directed shortest path \(S_2\), the time-respecting shortest path \(S_3\), and the depth \(D_e\) of the final site in a depth-first-search tree. Monte Carlo simulations for \(L\) up to 32768 give mean lengths scaling as \(L^{d_O}\), with \(d_{S_1}=1.48005(9)\), \(d_{S_2}=1.49868(5)\), \(d_{S_3}=1.51205(5)\), and \(d_{D_e}=1.7099(7)\), so that \(d_{S_1}<d_{S_2}<d_{S_3}<d_{\rm LE}<d_{D_e}\), where $d_{\rm LE}=1.62400(5)$ is the known loop-erased-random-walk exponent. Imposing traversal directions increases the shortest-path exponent, and imposing time order increases it further; these constraints therefore change the scaling exponent, not only the amplitude. For every path, the standard deviation scales with the same exponent as the mean, so it is scale-invariant, unlike the visited-site mass; the rescaled length distributions collapse onto a finite-width scaling function. No analytical theory currently predicts these exponents; our results provide precise numerical benchmarks for future studies of path geometry on random-walk traces.
summary:
1. 作者以蒙特卡洛模拟研究三维立方晶格随机游走迹上连接起终点的四类路径，比较方向、时间约束及深度优先搜索规则对长度标度的影响。
2. 三类最短路径指数依次为1.48005、1.49868和1.51205，表明方向与时间约束改变指数而非仅振幅；四类路径的重标度长度分布均呈有限宽度塌缩。
3. 这些结果为随机游走迹的路径几何提供精确数值基准，但相关指数尚无解析理论预测，其理论解释仍待建立。

title: I$_4$ complex acting as near-infrared emitter with a quantum memory in silicon
abstract: Silicon color centers emitting in the near infrared offer a route to spin--photon interfaces compatible with mature complementary metal--oxide--semiconductor fabrication. A key unresolved candidate is the X-line at 1039.7 meV in the photoluminescence (PL) spectrum, long attributed to a complex of four self-interstitials (I$_4$), yet whose microscopic structure and spin properties have remained controversial and uncharacterized at a predictive level. Using hybrid-functional (HSE06) density functional theory, we unambiguously establish the bare I$_4$ complex as the origin of the X-line: our calculations quantitatively reproduce the zero-phonon line, the complete phonon sideband structure---identifying the prominent secondary peaks as one- and two-phonon replicas of strongly coupled quasi-local modes---and the EPR hyperfine constants. The charge transition level is found at VBM$+$0.08~eV, conclusively ruling out the previously proposed association with the B3 EPR center and its correlated deep donor level. Most significantly, we identify a metastable spin-1 triplet excited state separated from the singlet by $\sim$1.6~meV, consistent with the NL51 EPR signal. The $D_{2d}$ symmetry of the defect suppresses intersystem crossing and phosphorescence by first-order spin--orbit coupling, implying an exceptionally long spin--lattice relaxation time. Combined with a spectrally resolvable zero-field splitting and near-infrared emission, the triplet state of the I$_4$ complex constitutes a viable spin quantum memory intrinsic to silicon.
summary:
1. 针对硅中X发光线的微观归属与自旋性质争议，作者以HSE06杂化泛函密度泛函计算研究四自间隙原子复合体I₄。
2. 计算复现零声子线、声子边带及超精细常数，支持裸I₄归属，并找到与单重态相隔约1.6毫电子伏的亚稳自旋三重态。
3. 缺陷对称性抑制一阶自旋轨道耦合引起的系间窜越与磷光，提示近红外自旋量子存储潜力，但长自旋弛豫时间及存储功能仍待实验验证。

title: Influence of hydrophobic polyelectrolyte composition on pH-dependent solubilization of lipid bilayer membranes
abstract: Lipid bilayer membranes can be solubilized in the form of disks of approximately 10 nm in diameter by several types of hydrophobic polyelectrolytes (HPE). The disks are stabilized by wrapped HPE along the rims of the disks. We compare the solubilization behavior of anionic HPE with chain lengths in between 20 - 100 monomers, and with varying molecular composition. We find that (1) HPE as short as 20 monomers can readily solubilize lipid bilayer membranes; (2) spatial intermolecular arrangement of ionic and hydrophobic groups in HPE determine if solubilization occurs; (3) anionic HPEs may exhibit two distinct pH-dependent solubilization transitions: the first is encountered in the lower-pH regime upon increasing the pH, whereas the second emerges at higher pH when the pH is decreased; (4) a binomial composition distribution of hydrophobic and ionizable groups over the chains, compared to a fixed composition, does not lead to a measurably wider pH range where solubilization occurs for the transition at low pH. We link the solubilization behavior of one of the HPE's to pH-dependent partitioning between macroscopic oil and water phases. Finally, (5) we find that linear composition superposition of the hydrophobic groups in HPE quantitatively accounts for the composition dependence of the pH's where solubilization occurs. This result holds within a range of compositions and breaks down below a critical fraction of hydrophobic residues in a HPE chain. Throughout, we compare the observations to a recently developed model for ligand-mediated cooperative transitions. Our findings have potential impact on anti-cancer medicine and drug delivery applications.
summary:
1. 作者比较链长为20—100个单体、组成不同的阴离子疏水聚电解质，研究其脂质双层增溶的pH依赖性，并与配体介导协同转变模型对照。
2. 短至20个单体的链即可增溶膜，体系可出现两种pH依赖转变，且疏水基团组成的线性叠加在一定范围内定量解释转变pH，但低于临界疏水比例时失效。
3. 结果为按组成调控膜增溶条件提供依据，但组成分布未显著拓宽低pH转变的增溶窗口，药物递送应用仍待验证。

title: Moiré-enabled chiral plasmons in twisted bilayer graphene nanoislands
abstract: Twisting two stacked graphene layers superimposes a moiré superlattice that reshapes their electronic structure, yet how it shapes the collective optical response of finite, nanoscale bilayers remains largely unexplored. Using an atomistic tight-binding and self-consistent density-matrix approach, we compute the twist-dependent plasmonic response of twisted bilayer graphene nanoislands comprising thousands of atoms. The spectra are strongly tunable and split into two regimes at a critical angle where a single moiré wavelength spans the island; beyond it, an ordered ladder of resonances emerges whenever an integer number of moiré periods fits within the overlapping bilayer. In doped islands, the interlayer coupling also produces a moiré-enabled Born--Kuhn chiral plasmon: opposite transverse dipoles in the two layers form an electric quadrupole that hybridizes with the bright dipole, opening an anticrossing near the critical angle, with a handedness that reverses with the twist direction. Triangular islands confirm that the moiré lattice, not the flake boundary, governs both effects, establishing twist as a mechanical handle on chiral graphene plasmons.
summary:
1. 针对有限尺寸双层石墨烯的莫尔结构如何塑造集体光学响应，作者以原子级紧束缚和自洽密度矩阵方法计算了含数千原子的扭转纳米岛。
2. 光谱在单个莫尔波长跨越岛体的临界角处分区，整数周期匹配产生共振阶梯，掺杂下层间反向横向偶极形成的电四极与明亮偶极杂化，出现反交叉及随扭转方向反转的手性。
3. 三角岛计算支持莫尔晶格而非边界主导这些效应，提示扭转可调控手性等离激元，但仍需实验验证。

title: Two-dimensional binary Lennard-Jones mixtures with ECMC
abstract: We discuss reversible and non-reversible local Monte Carlo algorithms for long-range two-dimensional binary Lennard-Jones mixtures. We illustrate how the factorized Metropolis filter efficiently handles long-range interactions even for binary mixtures, using an adapted cell-veto strategy. We then benchmark the non-reversible event-chain Monte Carlo (ECMC) algorithm against the factorized Metropolis algorithm. For simple test cases, we demonstrate speedups of several orders of magnitude in the equilibrium and the out-of-equilibrium dynamics. Using the ECMC algorithm, we provide an overview of the physics of binary Lennard-Jones mixtures, from the case without depletion (no interaction between solute and solvent) all the way to the depletion limit (with a diverging number of solvent particles). We analyze the algorithms in different thermodynamic phases and in the corresponding limits.
summary:
1. 针对二维二元伦纳德—琼斯混合物的长程相互作用采样，作者结合因子化梅特罗波利斯滤波与改进的单元否决策略，比较可逆局域算法和不可逆事件链蒙特卡洛算法。
2. 简单测试中，事件链算法在平衡与非平衡动力学采样上均实现数个数量级加速，并用于考察从溶质与溶剂无相互作用到溶剂粒子数发散的耗尽极限。
3. 结果支持用事件链算法研究不同热力学相及耗尽极限，但加速证据限于简单测试，不能据此推断所有相区的效率或真实物理动力学。

title: High-temperature expansion of the inverse-square Ising chain in a magnetic field: exact coefficients and finite-size reconstruction
abstract: The one-dimensional Ising chain with inverse-square interactions is a paradigmatic long-range system: it exhibits the unusual Thouless transition, with a discontinuity in the spontaneous magnetization, yet its full field-dependent thermodynamics remains unknown in closed form. We develop the high-temperature expansion of its free energy while retaining the dependence on a uniform magnetic field at every order. We prove that, after a natural rescaling of the coupling, each coefficient is a rational polynomial in the squared hyperbolic tangent of the reduced field. Remarkably, at each order $n$ the field-dependent free-energy coefficient of a finite, periodically repeated ring is an exact polynomial of degree at most $n$ in $L^{-2}$. The infinite-chain coefficient is its constant term and can therefore be reconstructed from $n+1$ finite rings without numerical extrapolation. Using this reconstruction, we determine the full field-dependent expansion through order 26: 26 polynomials containing 377 rational coefficient entries. We further derive exact formulas, valid at every order, for the coefficients of the two highest powers of the field variable using matching determinants and a cycle-Laplacian reduction. These results reveal an unexpected algebraic structure in the microscopic thermodynamics of the inverse-square chain and provide high-order information about its magnetic response.
summary:
1. 针对反平方相互作用伊辛链尚无闭式解的含场热力学，作者构建保留均匀磁场依赖的自由能高温展开，并以周期重复有限环重构无限链系数。
2. 证明第n阶系数是L⁻²的至多n次多项式，可由n＋1个有限环精确重构，获得至26阶的377个有理系数，并给出场变量最高两次幂系数的全阶公式。
3. 该代数结构为磁响应研究提供精确高阶信息，但尚未给出完整含场热力学闭式解，也未确立高温展开对转变区的适用性。

title: Quantum Hamiltonian time crystals from covariant quantum Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert relaxation
abstract: Classical Hamiltonian time crystals are constrained energy minima that move along symmetry orbits at frequencies set by Lagrange multipliers. We construct quantum counterparts by minimizing the energy over density matrices with fixed spectrum and charge expectations. A symmetry-covariant quantum Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert equation selects them as periodic attractors, preserving the spectrum and fixing the multipliers dynamically. A chiral spin trimer motivated by Cu$_3$ molecular magnets realizes this motion at a prepared magnetization, without a Zeeman term.
summary:
1. 针对受约束能量极小态如何形成量子哈密顿时间晶体，作者在固定密度矩阵谱和荷期望值下最小化能量，并构造对称协变的量子朗道—利夫希茨—吉尔伯特弛豫方程。
2. 该动力学保持密度矩阵谱、动态确定拉格朗日乘子并选出周期吸引子，且在受铜三分子磁体启发的手性自旋三聚体中，以预设磁化实现无塞曼项的周期运动。
3. 结果为分子磁体中的量子时间晶体研究提供理论路径，但摘要未给出实验验证，预设磁化条件下运动的实际制备与探测仍待探索。

title: Excitons in solid molecular hydrogen from quantum Monte Carlo
abstract: We use quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) methods to investigate the lowest neutral excitation of solid molecular hydrogen in phase-I under increasing compression, with emphasis on structural and response properties. We employ QMC wave functions for the excited state that feature only a single orbital substitution, or a multideterminant expansion including every single particle-hole transition, and compare the results with the Bethe-Salpeter equation (BSE) and time-dependent density-functional theory (TDDFT). We examine a number of nuclear configurations representing thermal and quantum fluctuations. The effect of the multideterminant expansion is marginal on the QMC excitation energies but crucial on the exciton localization and related quantities, irrespective of full optimization and imaginary time projection. In the strong insulating regime at low density, multideterminant QMC results match and in some cases surpass the degree of localization afforded by BSE. A similar trend is observed for transition dipole moments and excitation-induced forces, with generally good agreement between QMC and BSE but marked discrepancies for nuclear configurations where localization differs significantly. TDDFT generally gives a more extended exciton with correspondingly weaker transition dipole moments. These differences decrease upon compression, as the system approaches a semiconducting regime where multiple particle-hole transitions are less important.
summary:
1. 作者以单轨道替换和包含全部单粒子—空穴跃迁的多行列式量子蒙特卡罗波函数，研究压缩下Ⅰ相固态分子氢的最低中性激发，并与BSE及TDDFT比较。
2. 多行列式对激发能影响甚微，却显著改变激子局域化、跃迁偶极矩及激发诱导力，低密度时局域化程度与BSE相当或更高。
3. 压缩后方法间差异减小，提示接近半导体区时多粒子—空穴跃迁的重要性降低，但激发能接近并不足以保证响应性质可靠。

title: Kelvin-Wave Multiplication by Sound Emission
abstract: A subsonic Kelvin quantum can emit a phonon and split into two softer quanta, increasing Kelvin population while losing energy. In the soft-phonon limit, rotational invariance relates the leading acoustic shear amplitude, odd under reversal of phonon axial momentum, to the energy released. Microscopic calculations support this dispersion dependence. In a reflecting cavity with coherent sound and Kelvin seeds, Gross--Pitaevskii evolution shows Kelvin gain, larger mean-square displacement and smaller mean-square slope; a $\pi$ shift of the initial sound phase reverses these changes.
summary:
1. 作者研究亚声速开尔文量子如何通过发射声子分裂增殖，结合旋转对称性、微观计算与反射腔中的Gross–Pitaevskii演化分析其机制。
2. 软声子极限下，主导声学剪切振幅对声子轴向动量反演为奇并受释能约束；模拟显示开尔文增益伴随均方位移增大、均方斜率减小，初始声相移π则逆转这些变化。
3. 结果提示相干声场可用于调控开尔文波增殖与形态，但目前证据限于理论和特定反射腔模拟，实验可行性仍待检验。

title: Ensemble-dependent effect of disorder on multicritical points in a system with long-range interactions
abstract: We introduce two variants of the Blume--Emery--Griffiths model with long-range, mean-field-like interactions and quenched disorder. Although the two variants are described by different Hamiltonians, they yield the same free energy. Moreover, both Hamiltonians lead to the same average energy and hence to the same microcanonical entropy. The canonical and microcanonical phase boundaries differ markedly, and so does the multicritical behaviour of the two ensembles. In the microcanonical ensemble, tricritical points appear for any fraction of active spins, whereas in the canonical ensemble they emerge only when this fraction is sufficiently large. At lower fractions, canonical critical endpoints arise instead. We also report the formation of gaps in the entropy as a function of magnetization, another manifestation of ensemble inequivalence.
summary:
1. 为研究淬火无序如何影响长程系统的多临界行为，作者构建两种平均场型布卢姆–埃默里–格里菲斯模型，比较正则与微正则系综的相界及熵。
2. 两种哈密顿量给出相同自由能与微正则熵，但微正则三临界点在任意活跃自旋比例下均存在，正则系综则仅在比例足够高时出现，低比例下转为临界端点。
3. 熵随磁化强度变化时出现缺口，进一步表明系综不等价，因此该模型中无序对多临界性的影响须结合系综判断，能否推广至其他长程系统仍待检验。

title: Monte Carlo simulation of mixed spin-orbit ordering
abstract: The effect of a magnetic field on the thermodynamic properties of the Kugel-Khomskii model with maximal entanglement using the quasi-classical Monte Carlo method with the heat bath algorithm. The temperature dependencies of single-site correlators show that the application of a magnetic field results in non-zero magnetization and the simultaneous appearance of an orbital ordering at the same point in the Brillouin zone where a non-zero spin-orbit correlator exists.
summary:
1. 作者针对磁场如何影响最大纠缠情形下库格尔—霍姆斯基模型的热力学性质，采用热浴算法开展准经典蒙特卡洛模拟，分析单格点关联量的温度依赖。
2. 模拟显示，外场使磁化变为非零，并伴随轨道有序，其在布里渊区的位置与非零自旋—轨道关联量一致，揭示两类响应的联系。
3. 这一结果为研究外场调控自旋与轨道有序提供线索，但摘要未给出相界或临界行为，尚不能据此确立普适机制。

title: Microscopic Mechanism and Control of Reentrant Localization
abstract: Increasing quasiperiodic modulation can restore extended states after localization, raising the question of how the same modulation drives both localization and recovery. We identify a microscopic mechanism in quasiperiodic dimer chains by resolving scattering between Fourier channels. Specifically, scattering into neighboring channels and back shifts the spectral edge relative to a localization boundary determined by a neutral auxiliary resonance. Their successive crossings drive the same spectral packet with fixed integrated-density-of-states (IDS) labels into localization and back into an extended regime. This recovery persists across finite parameter ranges in both gap-opening families, including relative-phase detuning. Furthermore, an exact sublattice mapping enables compensated control of the recovery window and predicts recovery thresholds for individual IDS labels.
summary:
1. 针对准周期调制为何既致局域化又恢复扩展态，作者在准周期二聚链中分解傅里叶通道间散射，追踪固定积分态密度标签的谱包。
2. 相邻通道往返散射使谱边缘相对中性辅助共振确定的局域化边界移动，连续交叉驱动局域化与恢复，且恢复在两类开隙族及相对相位失谐下均占据有限参数范围。
3. 精确子晶格映射支持恢复窗口的补偿调控，并预测逐标签恢复阈值，为选择性控制提供依据，但摘要未报告实验验证。

title: Selective effects of selenium substitution on superconductivity and magnetic memory in 4Hb-TaS2
abstract: Disorder plays a central role in correlated quantum materials, but its effects can be highly selective when several electronic orders coexist. The van der Waals heterostructure 4Hb-TaS2 provides such a case, combining superconductivity, charge-order tendencies, strong scattering, and magnetic memory manifested through spontaneous vortices. Here we use Se substitution as a controlled local perturbation of the disorder landscape in 4Hb-TaS2. We find that superconductivity remains remarkably robust while the magnetic memory is strongly suppressed at higher Se concentrations. These results show that Se substitution does not create the hidden magnetic memory, but instead selectively weakens its macroscopic manifestation. More broadly, they reveal a sharp separation between robust superconducting and hidden-memory phases, and a highly disorder-sensitive spontaneous-vortex response in 4Hb-TaS2.
summary:
1. 针对共存电子序对无序的不同响应，作者在范德华异质结构4Hb-TaS₂中以硒替代作为局域扰动，考察超导与自发涡旋所体现的磁记忆。
2. 较高硒含量显著压低磁记忆的宏观表现，而超导保持稳健，揭示两者对替代扰动的选择性响应，并表明硒替代并非磁记忆的来源。
3. 结果提示可借局域无序调控自发涡旋响应而保留超导，但宏观记忆减弱尚不能证明隐藏磁序消失，其微观机制仍待厘清。

title: Thermodynamic Crossovers in Supercritical Matter: One, No One, and One Hundred Thousand
abstract: Beyond a critical point, two thermodynamic phases become continuously connected, without being separated by any thermodynamic singularity. The paradigmatic example is the liquid-gas transition, where several criteria have been proposed to distinguish liquid-like and gas-like regimes within the supercritical region. Recently, a pair of thermodynamic crossover lines, $L^\pm$, was introduced to address a proposed incompatibility of previous definitions with the universal critical behavior of the Ising model. These lines divide the supercritical region into three regimes, meet only at the critical point, and obey the expected critical scaling laws. Here, we demonstrate that these requirements do not uniquely determine the crossover boundaries. Instead, infinitely many pairs of lines satisfy the same conditions, with different choices of thermodynamic paths selecting different crossover boundaries. We further show that the Lee-Yang formalism, despite providing an intrinsic characterization of critical singularities, does not resolve this ambiguity in defining real-axis crossover boundaries. Restricting to regular probing paths that respect the $Z_2$ symmetry of the critical point recovers the Widom and $L^\pm$ prescriptions asymptotically. This restriction, however, is a choice of protocol rather than a property of the system, and even then two inequivalent prescriptions survive. Our results demonstrate that universal critical behavior alone does not select privileged supercritical thermodynamic crossover boundaries. While such lines may identify physically meaningful changes in thermodynamic, structural, or transport properties, their precise locations and the widths of the regions they delimit remain dependent on the operational criteria used to define them.
summary:
1. 针对超临界类液与类气分区能否由普适临界行为唯一确定，作者分析热力学探测路径、临界标度及Lee–Yang形式。
2. 无穷多对交叉线均满足既定分区与标度要求，Lee–Yang形式亦不能消歧；即使限于保持Z₂对称的正则路径，仍有两种不等价定义。
3. 这些交叉线可标识有物理意义的性质变化，但其位置及所界定区域的宽度依赖操作判据，不能仅由普适性选定。

title: Non-Bloch Dynamical Quantum Phase Transitions with Memory
abstract: Dynamical quantum phase transitions (DQPTs) of periodic chains are determined by real Bloch momenta. We identify non-Bloch DQPTs, which occur only in open chains and are determined by complex momenta instead. They arise in a Hermitian chain coupled to a simple substrate, whose memory is treated exactly, and originate from the point-gap winding number $W$ of the projected propagator: for $W\neq0$, open boundaries change both the dynamical free energy and the critical times, even in the thermodynamic limit. We find that both follow from an analytic continuation to complex momenta, and show that $W$ can be measured by particle counting. This reveals a dynamical bulk-boundary correspondence, in which non-Hermitian topology emerges from Hermitian dynamics with memory.
summary:
1. 作者研究边界如何改变动力学量子相变，在厄米链耦合简单基底的平台中精确处理记忆效应，识别由复动量决定、仅出现于开链的非布洛赫相变。
2. 投影传播子的点隙绕数非零时，开放边界对动力学自由能和临界时刻的影响在热力学极限仍存在，二者均由复动量解析延拓得到，且绕数可通过粒子计数测量。
3. 该结果揭示含记忆的厄米动力学可涌现非厄米拓扑及动力学体边对应，并为粒子计数检验提供路径，但摘要未报告实验实现。

title: Influence of pairing and correlations on transport properties in three-terminal superconducting nanostructure
abstract: We study the local and nonlocal charge transport properties of three-terminal nanostructure, consisting of the correlated quantum dot embedded between two metallic electrodes and superconductor. Using the linear response theory, we analyze interplay of the induced on-dot pairing with the correlation effects, inspecting their influence on the conductance and thermopower. Our calculations predict negative values of the nonlocal conductance and reversal of the Seebeck coefficient when the quantum dot ground state is represented by the BCS-type singlet configuration. These phenomena are realized when the subgap charge transport is predominantly contributed by the crossed Andreev scattering. In contrast, on the doublet side, we obtain signatures for the Kondo effect manifested by the low-temperature enhancement of the charge conductance and clearly evident in the thermopower. Such temperature-dependent local and nonlocal transport properties can unambiguously identify the specific configuration of the correlated quantum dot and reveal the rich physics emerging in the doublet-to-singlet crossover region.
summary:
1. 作者用线性响应理论研究连接两金属电极和超导体的关联量子点，分析诱导配对与电子关联如何影响局域及非局域电导和热电势。
2. 计算预测，交叉安德烈夫散射主导的BCS型单重态呈现负非局域电导及塞贝克系数反号，而双重态呈现近藤效应引起的低温电导增强和热电势特征。
3. 这些温度依赖输运特征可为辨识量子点基态及探测双重态至单重态交叉提供判据，但其有效性尚待实验检验。

title: Dynamical mean-field theory for associative memory with block-correlated patterns
abstract: In associative memories storing correlated patterns, retrieval of individual memories can compete with symmetric mixed states. A dynamical description is needed to determine how the initial state selects between these outcomes. We extend the generating-functional dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT) for independent patterns to independent blocks of correlated binary patterns of fixed finite size. The resulting effective single-neuron process has a self-consistent cross-talk noise covariance and self-feedback coefficients that depend on the block-covariance eigenvalues. For hierarchically correlated patterns with nonmonotonic transfer, increasing the loading can permit retrieval from an imperfect initial state before further loading prevents it. DMFT reproduces the retrieval trajectories and basin geometry found in direct simulations. Near the lower boundary of this re-entrant region, direct networks reveal stationary saddles separating coexisting mixed and target-retrieval states. Parameter sensitivities of DMFT trajectories predict nearby shifts of this boundary. At the tested upper boundary, retrieval remains accessible from initial states with larger target overlap, indicating a change in basin access. Under fixed-point convergence assumptions, the theory recovers the equations of generalized self-consistent signal-to-noise analysis.
summary:
1. 针对相关记忆中初态如何选择目标检索或混合态，作者以生成泛函将动力学平均场理论推广至有限大小的独立相关二元模式块，建立自洽单神经元过程。
2. 理论复现了层级相关模式与非单调响应下的检索轨迹和吸引域，揭示负载增加可先开启再阻断不完美初态的检索，且轨迹灵敏度可预测下边界的邻近移动。
3. 网络模拟显示下边界附近存在分隔共存态的鞍点，而所测上边界仍允许高目标重叠初态检索，提示该边界关乎吸引域可达性，并非检索态必然消失。

title: Quantum Metric Scaling and Its Exceptions in Classical Flat Bands
abstract: The quantum metric length has been proposed as the localization length scale in one-dimensional flat bands. Here, we study this quantum metric scaling and the exceptions to it in a classical flat band formed by a locally resonant mass--spring system. We find that the localization length follows the quantum metric length near the flat band but departs from this proportionality at the exact flat-band frequency. Selective mass disorder also produces divergent localization lengths or arbitrarily short tails near the flat-band frequency without changing the clean metric. These exceptions show that disorder can select localization scales beyond those predicted by the quantum metric alone.
summary:
1. 针对量子度规长度能否决定一维平带局域化尺度，作者在局域共振质量—弹簧系统中研究了局域化长度的度规标度及选择性质量无序的影响。
2. 平带附近局域化长度遵循度规长度标度，但在精确平带频率处偏离正比关系，且选择性质量无序可在不改变洁净系统度规的情况下，使附近的局域化长度发散或尾部任意短。
3. 这些例外表明量子度规不足以单独预测该经典系统的局域化尺度，后续描述需纳入无序的选择性作用，其对其他平带平台的适用性仍待检验。

title: Static Response of the Strongly Coupled Electron Gas from Diffusion Monte Carlo
abstract: The local field factor $G(q)$ of the HEG describes how exchange and correlation modify the response to a static perturbation, and enters dielectric screening, effective electron--electron interactions, and the xc kernel of TDDFT. Accurate zero-temperature data for $G(q)$, however, remain limited to metallic densities, $r_s\leq10$. In this work, we present diffusion Monte Carlo calculations of the static density response function $\chi(q)$ and of $G(q)$ for $2\leq r_s\leq100$, and describe and discuss the methodological steps that enabled these calculations. We show how optimization of the perturbing potential in the trial wave function has an important effect, as a poor choice can reverse the sign of the response. A closed-form expression is provided for its optimal value, together with the density dependence of the linear-response window. We further show that backflow correlations leave $\chi(q)$ unchanged and that $G(q)$ depends only weakly on system size even at very low density, so that Slater--Jastrow wave functions and modest system sizes suffice. Together, these results provide a practical guide for future QMC calculations of response properties of the electron gas and real materials. Our results agree with previous DMC data at metallic densities for $q>k_F$, and extend them below $k_F$. They also agree with diagrammatic QMC at $r_s=2$. At lower densities, our results show that $G(q)$ develops a nonmonotonic structure at intermediate-$q$, where the response approaches that of the noninteracting gas. Quantitative agreement is seen with finite-temperature path integral Monte Carlo, suggesting that the previously reported finite-temperature structure is inherited from the ground state. Using a parametrization of $G(q)$ that reproduces our data throughout the liquid phase, we relate this structure to short-range order in the pair correlation function and the static structure factor.
summary:
1. 为揭示强耦合均匀电子气的零温静态响应，作者用扩散蒙特卡洛计算了密度响应与局域场因子，覆盖密度参数2≤r_s≤100。
2. 计算发现低密度下局域场因子在中间波矢处呈非单调结构，并将其联系于短程有序；试探波函数中扰动势的优化至关重要，选取不当甚至会使响应变号。
3. 与有限温度路径积分蒙特卡洛的定量一致支持该结构源于基态，所得参数化和响应计算方案可供后续研究借鉴，但对真实材料的适用性尚待验证。

title: Continuous tuning of quantum critical behavior in hybrid Josephson junction arrays
abstract: We report finite-temperature scaling of voltage-driven quantum phase transitions in hybrid Josephson junction arrays. A dual-gate geometry separately tunes interisland coupling and proximity-induced superconductivity, providing access to superconducting, insulating, and metallic transport regimes. The critical resistivity and scaling exponent evolve continuously with electrostatic tuning. Where the three regimes converge, the critical resistivity approaches $h/4e^2$, consistent with the self-dual limit, while the scaling exponent approaches the quantum-percolation estimate. Tuning toward stronger insulating behavior raises the critical resistivity and shifts the scaling exponent toward the classical-percolation value, while both parameters decrease toward the metallic regime. These results connect scaling regimes previously reported in different two-dimensional superconducting systems through continuous electrostatic control.
summary:
1. 作者研究杂化约瑟夫森结阵列中电压驱动的量子相变，以双栅独立调控岛间耦合与近邻诱导超导性，并分析有限温度标度。
2. 临界电阻率与标度指数随栅控连续变化，三种输运区交汇处分别趋近自对偶值h/4e²与量子渗流估计，向绝缘侧则趋向经典渗流标度。
3. 结果以连续静电调控联系了不同二维超导体系中的标度区间，但趋近自对偶与渗流预期尚不等于确证相应微观机制。

title: Adiabatic Variational Principle: Born-Oppenheimer Theory for Emergent Electronic-Order Dynamics
abstract: Recent advances in microscopic many-body methods have enabled increasingly accurate descriptions of equilibrium quantum states, yet large-scale simulations of emergent-order dynamics typically rely on phenomenological equations with prescribed free-energy functionals. We introduce the Adiabatic Variational Principle (AVP), a framework for deriving order-parameter dynamics directly from an interacting many-body Hamiltonian. When microscopic relaxation is fast compared with order-parameter evolution, the many-body state follows the collective configuration adiabatically, in analogy with the Born--Oppenheimer separation of electronic and nuclear motion. This assumption makes explicit the adiabatic closure implicit in conventional phase-field descriptions. Each instantaneous order-parameter configuration then defines a constrained quasi-stationary many-body state, and the Lagrange multipliers enforcing these constraints directly provide the thermodynamic forces driving the collective evolution. Nonlinear Mori--Zwanzig projection theory further connects the reversible dynamics to the microscopic algebra of the collective variables and relates dissipation and fluctuations to the eliminated degrees of freedom. Applications to charge- and spin-density-wave dynamics recover Allen--Cahn domain growth, resolve evolving domain networks together with their microscopic electronic structure, and yield generalized Landau--Lifshitz dynamics for itinerant magnetism. The AVP thus provides a solver-independent microscopic foundation for phase-field-like simulations of the nonequilibrium dynamics of emergent electronic order.
summary:
1. 针对电子序参量动力学的微观推导，作者提出绝热变分原理，以受约束多体态及非线性投影理论，从相互作用哈密顿量构造驱动力、耗散与涨落。
2. 该框架恢复电荷与自旋密度波的Allen–Cahn畴生长，同时解析畴网络及电子结构，并导出巡游磁性的广义Landau–Lifshitz动力学。
3. 结果为相场式模拟提供不依赖特定求解器的微观基础，但依赖微观弛豫快于序参量演化，尚不能据此确认其在非绝热情形下的适用性。

title: Spin-Orbit Coupling Response Theory within the Oriented Spin Space Group Framework
abstract: Spin-orbit coupling (SOC) plays a pivotal role in a broad range of phenomena in condensed matter physics. The recently developed spin space group theory offers a new perspective for characterizing the fundamental symmetry-breaking features of SOC-related phenomena, yet its full potential remains to be explored. Here, we provide a general framework that relates the SOC-induced symmetry breaking to modifications of physical properties and emergence of new physical effects. This approach incorporates the recently developed oriented spin space group (OSSG) formalism, which can explicitly describe the symmetry reduction induced by SOC. By parameterizing the SOC Hamiltonian using a SOC tensor that connects real and spin spaces, an expansion in terms of the SOC components can be constructed for the response tensor describing any physical quantity. This framework determines not only whether a SOC-induced response is symmetry allowed, but also the lowest order in SOC at which it emerges and its dependence on magnetic anisotropy. As representative applications, we analyze the magnetoelectric coupling in Type-II multiferroics and show that magnetically induced electric polarization in different systems can be the result of SOC effects of different orders, and can exhibit varying characteristics of magnetic anisotropy. We further apply this theory to the anomalous Hall effect and spin magnetization in antiferromagnets, demonstrating that their distinct transformation properties under the OSSG allow a large anomalous Hall response to coexist with weak spin magnetization. A high-throughput analysis of materials in the MAGNDATA database identifies several symmetry-based material classes favorable for this coexistence. Overall, the proposed framework provides a unified symmetry description of SOC-induced phenomena and offers a systematic way for the identification of SOC-driven functional materials.
summary:
1. 针对自旋轨道耦合破缺对称性如何改变物性，作者在定向自旋空间群框架内以连接实空间与自旋空间的耦合张量展开响应。
2. 该理论判定响应是否允许、最低耦合阶次及磁各向异性，揭示多铁极化可源于不同阶次，并从对称性说明大反常霍尔响应可与弱自旋磁化共存。
3. 对MAGNDATA数据库的高通量分析筛出有利于上述共存的材料类别，为候选筛选提供依据，但对称性判据本身不保证实际响应幅度。

title: Chiral superconductivity on a closed Klein bottle: a chirality wall and its Majorana seam spectrum
abstract: We study a spinless $\pi$-flux lattice superconductor whose normal-state momentum-space fundamental domain is a Klein bottle. Within this model, a glide lift and a hidden antiunitary symmetry independently force the Bogoliubov--de Gennes (BdG) Chern number to vanish. A diagonal pairing breaks the antiunitary obstruction exactly when its real part is nonzero; this is necessary, not sufficient, for a chiral phase. We derive explicit Pfaffians determining Chern parity and identify three analytic families of gap closings in a real-pairing section. For a chiral state on a closed real-space Klein bottle, the prescribed pairing and gluing produce a $\Delta C=2$ chirality wall. A translation-invariant unfolding resolves two co-propagating Majorana branches. Their finite-size levels depend on circumference and holonomy; the near-zero pair is lifted at first order by allowed local seam perturbations. A cut-cylinder control has the same low-energy channel count, so gluing reconnects existing gapless content. We also distinguish literal gluing from deck projection: particle--hole symmetry exchanges the deck eigenblocks, precluding their interpretation as independent BdG quotient Hamiltonians. The contribution is a model-specific account of pairing compatibility and closed-surface seam spectra. The energy cost is evaluated for a fixed pairing background; neither a protected zero mode nor a self-consistent wall solution is claimed.
summary:
1. 作者以动量空间基本域为克莱因瓶的无自旋π通量晶格超导模型，分析配对的手性障碍，并用平移不变展开求解闭合实空间克莱因瓶的接缝谱。
2. 滑移提升与隐藏反幺正对称性分别迫使陈数为零；指定配对与粘合产生陈数差为二的手性畴壁，承载两支同向传播的马约拉纳模，但近零能级可被局域扰动一阶劈裂。
3. 结果阐明了该模型中配对与闭合曲面接缝谱的相容性，但粘合仅重连已有无隙通道，尚未证明受保护零模或自洽畴壁的存在。

title: Topological Quantum Spin Liquids in a Ladder with Majorana fermions and p-wave Superconductivity
abstract: In this article, we address the possibility of topological quantum spin liquids with only short-range (spin) correlations in the whole phase diagram in a ladder system, through an exactly solvable model which represents a generalization of the two-dimensional Kitaev honeycomb spin model to a ribbon geometry. This system gives rise to $\mathbb{Z}_2$ gauge fields emerging in a static way in the ground state through Majorana fermions which then produce either $0$ or $\pi$ flux. Through a quantum field theory perspective, mathematical and Density Matrix Renormalization Group results, we present our progress on the geometrical, topological and physical classification of this model through observables navigating on the whole phase diagram presenting three spin-liquid phases with a spin gap and a metallic phase in the sense of Majorana fermions. We propose a bulk-edge correspondence revealing the presence of protected zero-energy Majorana fermions at the edge in the phases with a gap and revealing also the presence of itinerant Majorana fermions in the bulk in the topological liquid phase. The proposed approach allows us to distinguish between properties of the brickwall ladder giving rise to a special line and those of the square ladder allowing for the gapless Majorana liquid phase. This model gives some hope on finding solutions for topological quantum spin models, e.g. with $\pi$ flux, on a square lattice geometry. This approach also allows for a correspondence onto models of topological superconductivity.
summary:
1. 作者以蜂窝Kitaev模型的可解梯带推广为平台，结合场论、数学分析与密度矩阵重整化群，研究全相图仅有短程自旋关联的拓扑自旋液体。
2. 相图包含三个有自旋隙的液体相及Majorana金属相，涌现静态零或π通量，并提出体边对应以刻画有隙相的受保护边缘零模。
3. 方梯带允许无隙Majorana液体，并可对应拓扑超导模型，为探索方晶格π通量自旋液体提供线索，但尚不构成二维实现的证明。

title: Multidimensional revival dynamics in a bosonic many-body system
abstract: The collapse and revival of localized states in many-body systems is a quintessential example of a quantum interference phenomenon that cannot be explained purely within mean-field theories. Historically, the majority of previous work on quantum revivals has been in a Schrödinger mechanics context, typically for effectively 1D systems with a focus on the autocorrelation function as the key detection observable. The general revival subject acquires a far greater complexity in the bosonic many-body context that offers a larger variety of observables and intrinsically implies high dimensionality. Here, the focus is on the simplest nontrivial (i.e., not 1D) bosonic many-body system, namely a symmetric two-site Bose-Hubbard model. The non-equilibrium situation of a coherent initial state prepared on one of the two sites of this integrable 2D system in the strongly self-trapping regime is considered. The revival behaviors emerging from the resulting dynamics within expectation values, coherences, and the autocorrelation function are theoretically derived, and the entanglement behavior is illustrated. Several new features, unknown so far in the Schrödinger context and identified here in terms of five ``puzzles'', are encountered and discussed, among them, a synchronized resurgence behavior, differing revivals times depending on the specific observable, and a manifestation of a precession that appears in the underlying mean field dynamics. These new phenomena can be entirely understood through a comprehensive semiclassical theory, building upon the underlying classical (mean-field) phase-space structure. A quantitative comparison of the latter with semiclassical predictions and quantum perturbative calculations yields an overall excellent agreement and confirms that a full semiclassical theory is pivotal for the understanding of these genuinely quantum many-body interference phenomena.
summary:
1. 针对多体量子复现如何依赖观测量的问题，作者在强自俘获的对称双位点玻色–哈伯德模型中，从单侧相干初态出发推导复现动力学，并以经典相空间构建半经典解释。
2. 结果揭示同步再现、观测量依赖的复现时间及平均场进动的量子印记，半经典预测与量子微扰计算吻合，表明平均场轨道之外的干涉结构不可忽略。
3. 该框架为理解多观测量中的多体复现提供了依据，但结论限于这一可积模型，能否推广至非可积系统仍待检验。

title: Light-induced chiral altermagnets from conventional antiferromagnets
abstract: Altermagnets combine compensated collinear magnetic order with momentum-dependent nonrelativistic spin splitting, offering new opportunities for spintronic applications. Here, we propose a route to optically induce altermagnetism through coherent lattice control. Using symmetry analysis, we identify phonon distortions that lift the spin degeneracy of conventional antiferromagnets while preserving the rotational symmetries connecting opposite-spin sublattices. Among these, geometric chiral phonons provide a particularly appealing pathway, linking the emergence of altermagnetism to structural chirality. Taking Fe$_2$TeO$_6$ as a prototype, we demonstrate that a linearly polarized mid-infrared pulse can drive a structural instability through negative biquadratic coupling between an infrared-active phonon and an optically silent, symmetry-breaking mode. First-principles-based lattice dynamics reveal the emergence of a transient chiral distortion, while electronic-structure calculations establish that the light-induced structure exhibits nonrelativistic spin splitting characteristic of altermagnetism. Our results establish a symmetry-guided pathway toward the ultrafast optical control of altermagnetic states through nonlinear phononics.
summary:
1. 作者以对称性分析和第一性原理晶格动力学研究常规反铁磁体的光致交替磁性，并以Fe₂TeO₆为例计算其电子结构。
2. 计算表明，线偏振中红外脉冲通过声子间负双二次耦合诱发瞬态手性畸变，在保留连接反向自旋子晶格的旋转对称性时产生非相对论性自旋劈裂。
3. 该理论结果为利用非线性声子学超快控制交替磁态提供了对称性导向的路径，但光致态的实验实现仍待验证。

title: Micromagnetic Lagrangian and Hamiltonian Normal-Mode Formulation of Cavity Magnon-Photon Interactions
abstract: We investigate magnon-photon interactions in a resonant cavity starting from the coupled Maxwell and Landau-Lifshitz equations linearized about an arbitrary micromagnetic ground state. By introducing an electric vector potential and a suitable interaction Lagrangian, the formulation avoids the cancellation of large magnetostatic contributions that arises in the conventional magnetic-vector-potential description and becomes inaccurate under modal truncation. The magnetization and cavity fields are expanded in the normal modes of the uncoupled magnetic and electromagnetic subsystems, with coupling coefficients given by overlap integrals of the corresponding eigenfunctions. The resulting multimode Lagrangian has a noncanonical structure due to the gyrotropic terms, and the corresponding Hamiltonian formulation is obtained using the Faddeev-Jackiw approach. The radiative magnon-photon interaction is encoded in the resulting Poisson-bracket structure, while the cavity-induced modification of the magnetostatic field enters explicitly in the Hamiltonian. The coupled system is diagonalized through a generalized Bogoliubov transformation, yielding canonical polariton variables that provide a natural basis for quantization. Application to a perpendicularly magnetized YIG disk in a rectangular microwave cavity shows hybridization between the cavity mode and several magnetostatic modes, together with appreciable cavity-wall-induced frequency shifts when the sample is placed close to the conducting walls.
summary:
1. 作者从任意微磁基态附近线性化的麦克斯韦与朗道—利夫希茨方程出发，以电矢势和正规模展开构建腔磁振子—光子耦合的拉格朗日及哈密顿框架。
2. 该方法避免传统表述中模态截断破坏大磁静力项抵消的问题，并在矩形腔内垂直磁化钇铁石榴石圆盘中展示多模杂化及近导电壁处的显著频移。
3. 广义玻戈留波夫变换所得正则极化激元变量为量子化提供基础，但摘要仅展示线性化理论应用，尚未报告量子效应或实验验证。

title: Seeding and Amplification of Chaos in Long-Range Interacting Spin Chains
abstract: Truncating weak interactions is a natural simplification of a many-body Hamiltonian, but the validity of this approximation need not be uniform in distance and time. In a chaotic system, a weak long-range coupling can seed a small disturbance far from its source, after which the local dynamics can amplify that disturbance exponentially. We study this mechanism in an infinite-temperature classical Heisenberg spin chain with a dominant nearest-neighbor exchange and a weak interaction tail. Using a classical decorrelator, we compare exponentially and power-law decaying tails over several decades in interaction strength. For exponentially decaying interactions, the long-distance front remains ballistic when the tail is sufficiently shallow, with a velocity controlled by the competition between the spatial decay of the seed and the local chaotic growth. For sufficiently rapid exponential decay, the nearest-neighbor front, which is defined by an intrinsic butterfly velocity $v_b$, is recovered within the accessible space-time window. For power-law interactions, the arrival time is logarithmic in distance for all exponents studied, corresponding to an exponentially expanding spatial front; the power-law exponent controls the coefficient of this logarithm. We interpret both behaviors using a seeding-and-amplification picture in which long-range couplings generate weak disturbances throughout the chain whose growth is governed primarily by the local nearest-neighbor dynamics. In this picture, the overall strength of the tail primarily controls when the long-range front becomes visible, while its spatial decay controls the propagation law. Thus a weak interaction tail can leave conventional spin-dynamical observables essentially unchanged while qualitatively altering the long-distance propagation of decorrelation.
summary:
1. 作者在无限温经典海森堡自旋链中，以去关联量比较弱指数与幂律相互作用尾，研究截断远程耦合对混沌传播的影响。
2. 远程播种与局域放大使缓衰减指数尾保持弹道前沿，而所考察幂律尾均使到达时间随距离呈对数增长；尾强度主要决定其显现时间。
3. 弱尾即使几乎不改变常规自旋动力学观测量，也可能重塑远距去关联传播；快速指数衰减下最近邻前沿的恢复仅在可及的时空窗口内得到验证。

title: Teleported free energy simulations
abstract: Escorted free energy simulations reduce dissipation with a flow field that follows the equilibrium distribution. A continuous flow, however, cannot transfer probability between metastable basins. We show that any escort then faces a variance floor set by the change in basin weights, and lift it by adding teleportation: jumps at a rate proportional to the driving rate. We derive the corresponding nonequilibrium identity, the zero-dissipation condition, and the minimal number of jumps it requires, and illustrate the gain on an exactly solvable model and a tilted double well.
summary:
1. 针对连续流引导的自由能模拟无法在亚稳盆地间转移概率的问题，作者引入速率正比于驱动速率的跳跃，并推导相应非平衡恒等式。
2. 作者证明连续引导的方差下限由盆地权重变化决定，给出跳跃解除该限制的零耗散条件及所需最少跳跃次数，并以可精确求解模型和倾斜双阱展示收益。
3. 该方法为克服亚稳态权重重分配造成的自由能估计瓶颈提供路径，但其在复杂多盆地体系中的可实现性与计算收益仍待检验。

title: Quasi-Phases of Quantum Matter
abstract: Within quantum many-body phase diagrams, continuous transition lines can appear and then terminate. However, it has remained unclear whether the neighboring regimes can be meaningfully described as distinct phases, akin to water and vapour, since any sharp characterization would have to go beyond the usual notion of phases of matter. We answer this in the affirmative by introducing quasi-phases: gapped regimes near a critical point that are connected in the broader phase diagram, but not by any gapped path accessible from small perturbations of the critical theory. The physical consequences include interface modes between regimes in the same phase of matter. More striking still, describing both the extended critical line and the gapped path connecting the regimes requires a bigger multicritical parent theory. In spin-chain examples with continuous terminating lines with central charge $c=1$, we find multicritical $c=3/2$ and $c=9/5$ orbifolds describing so-called 'quotient symmetry protected' and 'representation symmetry protected' topological phenomena. While one-dimensional symmetry-protected topological phases are labeled by projective representation classes, these quasi-phases can have interface modes carrying higher-dimensional linear representations. We turn this into a constructive principle through a weakening of the Lieb-Schultz-Mattis anomaly. Supporting distinct quasi-phases makes an unnecessary critical point infrared-necessary, even if it is unnecessary at the ultraviolet scale. This condition is more restrictive than simply having a codimension-one critical line, revealing richer structure within phases of matter than their conventional classification suggests.
summary:
1. 针对连续相变线终止后相邻有隙区域能否区分，作者定义无法由临界理论小扰动下的有隙路径连接的“准相”，并用自旋链研究其结构。
2. 这些同属一个常规相的区域可有携带高维线性表示的界面模，而同时描述其连接路径与中心荷c=1临界线需要c=3/2或9/5的多临界轨形母理论。
3. 弱化Lieb–Schultz–Mattis反常提供了构造准相的原则，揭示常规相分类之外的内部结构，但所举实例限于一维自旋链。

title: Odd Elasticity in Strain-Gradient Continua: Anisotropy Classification and Non-Hermitian Elastodynamics
abstract: Odd elasticity extends continuum mechanics to active nonconservative systems containing internal energy sources, such as robotic active metamaterials with nonreciprocal feedback. Modeling these systems as effective continua requires relaxing Maxwell-Betti reciprocity, which results in stiffness tensors lacking major symmetry. In this contribution, we extend this framework to 3D strain-gradient odd elasticity to incorporate the length scales inherent in these heterogeneous systems. By applying the full hierarchy of 3D point-group symmetries along chiral and achiral branches, we derive the exhaustive set of fourth-, fifth-, and sixth-order odd elastic stiffness tensors. Further, utilizing the dynamic principle of virtual work, we formulate the equilibrium equations, higher-order boundary conditions, and the generalized acoustic tensor for elastodynamic analysis. The results demonstrate that nonreciprocal moduli survive even under full isotropy in the sixth-order stiffness, under hemitropy in the fifth-order stiffness, and under cubic symmetry in fourth-order stiffness. In contrast, the elastodynamic analysis reveals that under isotropic and hemitropic limits, despite the underlying odd stiffness moduli, the acoustic tensor remains unconditionally Hermitian. Non-Hermitian elastodynamics is shown to require anisotropy. By numerically analyzing a transversely hemitropic odd elastic continuum, we demonstrate that this symmetry reduction results in non-Hermitian elastodynamic phenomena including exceptional points in the dispersion spectra and active energy exchange through simultaneous amplification and attenuation of the elastic wave components. These results provide the necessary theoretical foundation for future multiscale homogenization frameworks for anisotropic strain-gradient active microstructures, and for the design of nonreciprocal strain-gradient metamaterials.
summary:
1. 针对主动介质内禀尺度与非互易性的连续体描述，作者建立三维应变梯度奇弹性理论，按点群穷尽分类四至六阶奇刚度张量，并由动态虚功原理推导控制方程与声学张量。
2. 六阶各向同性奇刚度仍可存在，但各向同性与半各向同性极限下声学张量均为厄米；横向半各向同性数值模型则呈现异常点及波分量同时放大与衰减，表明非厄米动力学需要各向异性。
3. 该理论可为主动微结构的多尺度均匀化及非互易梯度超材料设计提供基础，但相关现象尚限于理论与数值展示。

title: Algebraic theory of abelian fractons and beyond
abstract: We develop an algebraic theory of fusion, mobility, and statistics in abelian gapped fracton orders and topological phases. The framework generalizes the algebraic description of abelian anyons to systems with restricted-mobility and spatially extended excitations. We consider translation-invariant bosonic systems whose pointlike and extended excitations have finite fusion order. The basic objects are braided fusion complexes (BFCs): chain complexes encoding fusion and mobility, equipped with a braiding chain map encoding statistics. Their equivalence classes define braided fusion theories (BFTs). Our framework encompasses arbitrary translation-invariant Pauli codes, as well as all abelian anyon theories in two spatial dimensions, including chiral theories. We give evidence for the conjecture that every nondegenerate BFT can be realized as the excitation theory of a gapped phase and that the BFT describing such a phase is a phase invariant. We derive constraints on pointlike fusion and mobility, showing, for example, that neither the Pauli X nor Z sectors of the X-cube and anisotropic models can occur alone in a nondegenerate BFT. For nondegenerate theories with only pointlike excitations, we extract a simpler theory of mutual statistics, consisting of a fusion module and a map to its statistical dual. This theory of mutual statistics is an invariant of the BFT and, at odd fusion order, gives an equivalent description of the full braided fusion theory. We interpret remote detection as the generalization of mutual statistics to fracton orders. In the BFC setting, we give a precise formulation of the excitation-detector principle: every nontrivial excitation can be detected by an operator supported at spatial infinity, and every nontrivial detector detects some excitation. Assuming a unique infinite-space ground state, we prove that this principle is equivalent to nondegeneracy.
summary:
1. 针对分形子激发的融合、受限迁移与统计，作者在平移不变、激发融合阶有限的玻色系统中，以链复形和编织链映射建立统一代数框架。
2. 该框架涵盖任意平移不变泡利码及二维阿贝尔任意子理论，并证明在无限空间基态唯一时，激发与无穷远探测器相互可检测的原则等价于非退化性。
3. 这一框架为比较分形子序提供代数工具，但非退化理论均可由有隙相实现、且其等价类构成相不变量，目前仍是有证据支持的猜想。

title: Variational wavefunctions for ideal anyon gas: superfluid and skyrmion Hall crystal
abstract: The ground state of an ideal gas of anyons with statistical angle $\theta\in(0,\pi)$ is a long-standing open problem, with renewed interest from the recent observations of fractional Chern insulators. In this work we construct variational wavefunctions that build in the exact anyon statistics and combine theory-guided composite-boson, composite-fermion and parton wavefunctions with neural-network correlations on the sphere. For spinless and SU(2) semions we confirm the paired anyon superfluid, well below the best crystal states. At $\theta=\pi/3$ liquids and crystals are closer in energy for the spinless case. For $\theta=\pi/3$ anyons with SU(3) flavor, we find two candidates. One is a skyrmion Hall crystal, in which the anyons form an integer quantum Hall state in the effective magnetic field from the spin texture. The other is a chiral color superconductor of six-anyon clusters, the color-flavor-locked pairing descendant of a holon metal with SU(3) color gauge symmetry and SU(3) flavor symmetry; its wavefunction is a hyperdeterminant rather than a product of parton determinants. Within our variational ansatz the color superconductor has better energy than both crystals and the color-flavor locked phases with U(1)$^2$ and Z$_3$ gauge groups. For twisted MoTe$_2$ this suggests that the reentrant integer quantum anomalous Hall phase is the skyrmion Hall crystal of the doped anyons, and that the observed superconductivity may be the color superconductor, which can undergo a transition to an $f+if$ BCS superconductor with a jump of the chiral central charge by 3.
summary:
1. 针对理想任意子气体的基态问题，作者在球面上结合复合粒子、部分子波函数与神经网络关联，构造严格满足任意子统计的变分态。
2. 半任意子配对超流的能量显著低于晶体；统计角π/3、SU(3)味情形出现斯格明子霍尔晶体与六任意子团簇手征色超导候选，后者在所考察变分态中能量更低。
3. 这些候选态为扭转MoTe₂中的重入整数反常霍尔相和超导提供可能解释，但变分比较尚不能确立真实基态或实验对应。

title: Creation of the Universe in Lorentzian Classical Gravity
abstract: The singularity theorems and the past incompleteness of inflationary spacetimes suggest that the beginning of the Universe lies beyond the domain of semiclassical gravity. We show that the creation of the Universe can nevertheless be understood within Lorentzian gravity by allowing gravitational junctions, so that the full spacetime need not be a smooth manifold. We construct rotationally invariant cosmic creation gates joining any finite number $n\geq2$ of locally de Sitter regions in $D\geq3$ spacetime dimensions at a timelike perfect-fluid junction with $P=w\rho$. For $w>-(D-3)/(D-2)$, they are geodesically complete in both temporal directions. The total spatial volume approaches finite, positive limits in the infinite past and future on the global-time foliation adapted to the junction fluid. We also construct exact deformed cosmic creation gates through nonlinear homogeneous backreaction that retain the initial volume while the future volume grows without bound. In these solutions, the junction fluid always expands, cooling for $w>0$ and heating for allowed $w<0$. Keeping the bulk regions locally de Sitter, we determine the linearized perturbations: in three dimensions, the generic inhomogeneous sector contains one hybrid sound mode and $n-1$ relative transverse modes; in four and higher dimensions, only the homogeneous hybrid sound mode survives. A finite-volume beginning requires fine-tuned homogeneous and inhomogeneous initial data, while causal response generically leads to unbounded future spatial volume. We also discuss a broader creation criterion allowing bounded past-volume oscillations. The gravitational equations determine conditioned admissible histories. We discuss implications for cosmology.
summary:
1. 针对宇宙起源是否超出经典引力的问题，作者在洛伦兹引力中引入类时理想流体接合，构造连接多个局部德西特区域的旋转不变宇宙模型。
2. 在给定状态方程条件下，模型双向测地完备且过去空间体积有限为正，非线性均匀反作用还可保留初始体积并使未来体积无界增长。
3. 这些解展示了非光滑时空中的经典起源可能性，但有限体积起点需要精细调节初始数据，尚不能视为稳健的宇宙生成机制。

title: Black Hole Entropy from Entangled Quantum Reference Frames
abstract: In the extended phase space of Donnelly and Freidel, the edge modes of a Schwarzschild black hole are dynamical reference frames whose phase space is the cotangent bundle of $\mathrm{SL}(2,\mathbb{R})$. Gluing the two exterior regions at the bifurcation point leaves a single canonical pair. Within the extended phase space, this pair can be described either by Kuchař's mass and difference of asymptotic times or by the area and the relative rapidity of the two frames, which are two gauge choices of the same system. The latter is the pair of Carlip and Teitelboim, and the relative rapidity is the time shift of the crossed product construction. We quantize the frames in this gauge and construct the gravitational entangling product of the two exteriors. Requiring the frames to be causal restricts them to the semigroup $\mathrm{SL}^+(2,\mathbb{R})$, whose Plancherel measure yields the Bekenstein--Hawking entropy as the entanglement entropy between the two exteriors, together with a logarithmic correction, both independent of the ultraviolet cutoff.
summary:
1. 作者在扩展相空间中将史瓦西黑洞边缘模视为动力学量子参考系，量子化面积与相对快速度这一正则对，构造两侧外部区域的引力纠缠积。
2. 因果性将参考系限制于SL⁺(2,ℝ)半群，其普朗歇雷尔测度给出贝肯斯坦—霍金熵及对数修正，二者均不依赖紫外截断。
3. 结果为黑洞熵提供了两侧参考系纠缠的解释，但论证限于所用史瓦西黑洞相空间与因果性条件，能否推广至其他黑洞仍待检验。

title: Holomorphic fermions in $\text{AdS}_{2}$
abstract: On two-dimensional Anti-de Sitter space, Majorana fermions with a discrete set of finely tuned, non-zero mass parameters possess conserved spinor--tensors that are symmetric and traceless. In complex coordinates, these correspond to pairs of holomorphic and anti-holomorphic half-integer spin currents and admit Laurent series mode expansions reminiscent of standard two-dimensional conformal field theories. We exploit this fact in order to fully parameterise the classical phase space associated with the equation of motion in terms of arbitrary (anti-)holomorphic functions. We further show that this parameterisation can be written covariantly in terms of a conformal Killing spinor--tensor, hinting at a hidden conformal symmetry. We also show they possess chiral algebras which are strict subalgebras of the one present in the corresponding theory on flat space.
summary:
1. 作者研究二维反德西特空间中特殊非零质量的马约拉纳费米子，利用守恒旋量张量及其全纯分解，以任意全纯与反全纯函数完整参数化经典运动方程的相空间。
2. 离散精调质量下存在半整数自旋手征流及洛朗模展开，相空间参数化可借共形基灵旋量张量协变化，其手征代数严格包含于对应平直空间理论的代数。
3. 这些结构提示隐藏共形对称性，但尚非对该对称性的确证，结论限于离散精调质量，量子层面的实现仍待研究。

title: Quiver Lab -- A Computing Tool for Quiver Gauge Theories
abstract: Quiver Lab is a browser-based workspace for drawing quivers and exploring the moduli spaces of three-dimensional $\mathcal{N} = 4$ theories. It computes Higgs and Coulomb branch Hilbert series, plethystic logarithms, supported refinements, and Decay and Fission Hasse diagrams. This note explains the Light and Expert workflows and the main computational methods
summary:
1. 为研究三维𝒩＝4箭图规范理论的模空间，作者开发浏览器工作台Quiver Lab，结合箭图绘制与Light、Expert两种工作流程开展计算。
2. 该工具可计算希格斯支与库仑支的希尔伯特级数、赝对数及所支持的精细化形式，并生成衰变与裂分哈斯图，将多类模空间分析功能整合于同一界面。
3. 这一平台可辅助探索模空间结构，但摘要未给出性能基准、适用理论范围或新的物理结论，尚不足以判断其计算优势与普适性。

title: Go with the flow(s): radial de Sitter holography and $T^2 (+ Λ_2)$
abstract: What can we learn about a putative dual to de Sitter spacetime from the bulk? Conversely, what can a candidate dual theory teach us about the bulk? In this work, we construct midisuperspace Wheeler-DeWitt states that are localised on the Schwarzschild-de Sitter spacetime. Using these states, we construct a slice-independent worldtube holographic framework in the static patch. We then construct a dictionary between this worldtube proposal and both the $T^2$ and $T^2 + \Lambda_2$ frameworks for cut-off holography. In doing so, we provide a bulk realisation of $T^2+ \Lambda_2$ for dS$_4$ black holes. We identify the average Hamiltonian of our worldtube proposal as the seed energy of the $T^2 (+ \Lambda_2)$ theories. To recover the $T^2 (+ \Lambda_2)$ energy spectrum as the average Hamiltonian of a worldtube theory, one must make the bulk framework slice-dependent, and we discuss the consequences of this trade-off.
summary:
1. 为探索德西特时空的候选对偶，作者构造局域于史瓦西—德西特几何的中间超空间惠勒—德维特态，在静态区建立不依赖切片的世界管全息框架。
2. 通过与截断全息的T²及T²＋Λ₂框架建立字典，作者给出后者在四维德西特黑洞中的体实现，并将世界管平均哈密顿量识别为种子能量。
3. 该构造为检验候选对偶提供体侧依据，但以世界管平均哈密顿量复现形变理论能谱须引入切片依赖，凸显能谱匹配与切片独立性的取舍。

title: Differential Equations for Dressed "in-in" Correlators
abstract: We extend the formalism of differential equations and Integration-by-Parts identities, to cosmological in-in correlators of conformally coupled scalar fields, that can be formulated as dressed flat space amplitudes. These differential equations turn out to be quite powerful for extracting information about the class of functions which the corresponding amplitudes integrate to. Furthermore, they can be formulated algorithmically. Here we illustrate this for the cosmological bubble- triangle and exchange diagram.
summary:
1. 针对宇宙学共形耦合标量场的in-in关联函数，作者将微分方程与分部积分恒等式方法推广至可表示为缀饰平直时空振幅的情形。
2. 该框架可算法化构建微分方程，提取相应振幅积分所得函数类别的信息，并以宇宙学泡图、三角图及交换图作示范。
3. 这一方法为系统分析此类宇宙学关联函数的解析结构提供了路径，但对更一般场论及图结构的适用性仍待检验。

title: Near-horizon BF bounds for the $t^+$ KK tower on extremal AdS$_5$ black holes
abstract: We study the charged Breitenlohner--Freedman (BF) bound for all horizon harmonics of the type IIB $t^+$ Kaluza--Klein tower on extremal charged AdS$_5$ black holes with equal rotations. The scalar equation follows from maximal five-dimensional gauged supergravity at level zero and the linearized exceptional-field-theory equations at higher levels. For aligned charge and rotation, a quadratic form in charge and spin changes signature on the curve of supersymmetric (BPS) black holes, where every mode satisfies the bound. Above the curve, where $\Omega_H>1$, every black hole has a violating mode, although no finite truncation in level or spin detects violation at every such black hole. Below the curve, where $\Phi_H>1$, the BF-passing set is confined to a thin strip and controlled by charge and spin discreteness. At large radius and fixed rotation, a level-four mode with spin proportional to the radius violates the bound even where all U(2) singlets satisfy it. These results concern the near-horizon BF bound of one tower in two-derivative supergravity; full radial stability remains open.
summary:
1. 作者结合五维规范超引力与线性化例外场论，考察等旋转极端带电AdS₅黑洞上IIB型t⁺塔全部视界谐波的带电近视界BF界。
2. 电荷与旋转同向时，BPS曲线上各模均满足界，曲线上方每个黑洞均有违界模但任何有限截断都无法覆盖全部黑洞，且大半径下第四层非单态可揭示单态遗漏的违界。
3. 结果表明高层级与非单态对近视界判据不可忽略，但仅限双导数超引力中的单个塔，完整径向稳定性仍待检验。

title: Quotient Quiver Subtraction -- Product Groups
abstract: Quotient quiver subtraction translates the gauging of Coulomb branch global symmetries into a combinatoric operation on 3d $\mathcal{N}=4$ gauge theories. This work uses brane systems to introduce a systematic method to gauge $\textrm{U}(n)\times\textrm{U}(n')$ and $\textrm{SU}(n)\times\textrm{SU}(n')$ emergent Coulomb branch global symmetries. Similar to other recently-introduced techniques, the gauging operation is a two-step process; in this case, it involves the symplectisation of unitary gauge factors into symplectic groups. A host of explicit examples are used to verify the procedure, and connections are made to Class $\mathcal{S}$ theories and three-dimensional theories realising maximal implosion spaces.
summary:
1. 针对三维𝒩=4规范理论中涌现的库仑支整体对称性如何规范化，作者借助膜系统构建了适用于两类酉群与特殊酉群乘积的商箭图减法。
2. 该方法将规范化转化为两步组合操作，关键是把酉规范因子转为辛群，并以多个显式例子检验流程。
3. 与S类理论及实现极大内爆空间的三维理论的联系提示了应用方向，但摘要未确立该流程对更一般乘积群的适用性。

title: Covering Surfaces, Conical-Defect Continuation, and Multi-Entropy at Arbitrary Genus
abstract: We derive normalized geometric factors for permutation-twist correlators at arbitrary genus. For three uniformly ramified branch values, hypergeometric uniformization shows that the real part of the continued conical-defect exponent equals the covering-space anomaly factor. Its imaginary part is an Euler-characteristic Weyl phase. We extend the normalization to additional branch values, derive higher replica-index corrections to the geometric multi-entropy, and state the extra condition required for a holographic limit. A reducible conformal/topological example demonstrates why large central charge alone does not fix the complete entanglement result.
summary:
1. 针对任意亏格置换扭曲关联函数的几何归一化，作者以超几何均匀化研究锥缺陷延拓与覆盖空间反常的联系，并推广至更多分支值。
2. 对三个均匀分歧的分支值，延拓指数的实部等于覆盖空间反常因子、虚部为欧拉示性数控制的外尔相位，并导出几何多重熵的高阶副本指标修正。
3. 可约共形／拓扑模型表明，大中心荷不足以确定完整纠缠结果，全息极限仍需额外条件，所得几何归一化不能直接视为完整的全息纠缠答案。

title: Entropically favored scalar hair on AdS black branes
abstract: We construct neutral AdS$_5$ black branes with source-free scalar hair that is entropically favored over the symmetric phase. A quadratic scalar--Gauss--Bonnet coupling destabilizes the thermal state while leaving the ultraviolet operator dimension fixed at $\Delta=3$. The fully backreacted solutions require only a quadratic scalar potential. We describe how a neural-network search led to this simple model.
summary:
1. 作者研究无源标量毛发能否在熵上优于对称相，通过神经网络搜索模型，构造了包含完整反作用的中性五维反德西特黑膜解。
2. 二次标量与高斯—博内项的耦合使热态失稳，同时保持紫外算符维数Δ=3，且仅需二次标量势便得到熵更高的有毛相。
3. 该模型为研究高曲率耦合驱动的自发标量化提供了简洁平台，但熵优势尚不等同于动力学稳定性，后者仍待检验。

title: Circuit complexity of coupled four-mode squeezed states in two-field inflation
abstract: We study the circuit complexity of coupled curvature and entropy perturbations in two-field inflation. We start from the quadratic action and derive the full Hamiltonian. The Hamiltonian includes all diagonal and off-diagonal quadratic terms. We then obtain three coupled equations for the pair amplitudes of the four-mode squeezed state. From these amplitudes, we calculate the two principal squeezing strengths. We use them to determine the Nielsen circuit complexity. For an equal-weight Gaussian circuit, the complexity takes the form $\mathcal{C}_{2,k}=\sqrt{2(r_{1k}^{2}+r_{2k}^{2})}$. It depends on the squeezing strengths but not explicitly on the squeezing angles. Our numerical results show that the complexity grows after horizon crossing in both coupled and uncoupled models. Interfield coupling changes the pair amplitudes and the four-mode squeezed state. However, its effect on the circuit complexity is small for the parameters considered. This result shows that different four-mode pair-amplitude matrices can yield similar values of the chosen equal-weight circuit complexity. The present calculation provides a reference for studying Gaussian circuit complexity in more general two-field inflationary models.
summary:
1. 针对双场暴胀中曲率与熵扰动的回路复杂度，作者由完整二次哈密顿量推导四模压缩态的配对振幅方程，并以主压缩强度计算尼尔森复杂度。
2. 等权高斯回路复杂度不显含压缩角，数值上在越过视界后增长；所考察参数下，场间耦合虽改变配对振幅，对复杂度的影响却较小。
3. 结果表明这一等权复杂度难以区分部分不同的配对振幅矩阵，可为更一般双场模型提供基准，但耦合影响较弱的结论仍受所选参数与度量限制。

title: Tachyon and massless sectors of the bosonic string effective action
abstract: Recently, it has been observed that in certain schemes of the bosonic string effective action, the non-derivative tachyon appears only in the tachyon potential, while all other couplings involve covariant derivatives of the tachyon and massless fields. Within these schemes, a minimal basis can be found whose coupling constants are constrained by T-duality upon circle reduction. Using this constraint, one obtains sets of couplings at each order of \(\alpha'\) that are invariant under Buscher rules supplemented by higher-derivative corrections for all base-space fields except the tachyon. In this paper, we observe that consistency of these T-dual sets with S-matrix elements requires an appropriate field redefinition, such that each set becomes invariant under Buscher rules supplemented by higher-derivative corrections for all base-space fields except the metric, dilaton, and tachyon. This separates the couplings into a massless sector and a tachyon sector. We determine the six-derivative couplings in the massless sector, with all coupling constants fixed, and find two T-dual couplings in the tachyon sector with arbitrary coupling constants. We show that the leading-order action and the massless-sector couplings exactly reproduce the expansion of the sphere-level S-matrix element of two tachyons and two massless vertex operators at six-momentum order, and that the coupling constant of the four-tachyon coupling in the tachyon sector is fixed by the expansion of the four-tachyon S-matrix element at six-momentum order.
summary:
1. 作者研究玻色弦有效作用中快子与无质量场的耦合，以圆约化下的T对偶和散射振幅约束场重定义，分离两类耦合扇区。
2. 无质量扇区六导数耦合系数全部确定，并精确复现两快子与两无质量态球面振幅的六动量阶展开；快子扇区两项T对偶耦合中，四快子项系数由相应振幅固定。
3. 结果为结合T对偶与散射振幅约束更高阶有效作用提供路径，但依赖特定场变量选择，摘要未给出快子扇区全部系数的确定。

title: The Topological String on the Quintic to Genus 83 and the Rank-Two D4-D2-D0 Indices
abstract: We compute quintic Gopakumar-Vafa invariants for genera 2-83 and degrees up to 44 by integrating the holomorphic anomaly equations. Under rank-one modularity for the required Gieseker invariants and rank-two charge conjugation, a coupled system of boundary and surplus wall-crossing equations fixes the holomorphic ambiguities and 22 of the 36 polar rank-two D4-D2-D0 coefficients, without assuming any rank-two index. A computer-assisted extension of wall crossing supplies additional equations and the boundary datum needed to close the recursion through genus 83. With known low-genus input, the GV data are complete through degree 32 and yield PT and DT tables. Selected higher-genus wall-crossing invariants reach genus 216; 33 entries require additional hypotheses. Retrospectively selected extrapolations give conditional candidates at genera 84 and 85 and, with rank-two mock modularity, for the remaining polar coefficients.
summary:
1. 为求五次超曲面的高亏格拓扑弦不变量，作者积分全纯反常方程，结合边界条件、越墙方程及计算机辅助递推，算至亏格83、次数44。
2. 在秩一模性与秩二电荷共轭假设下，无需预设秩二指标即可确定全纯歧义及36个秩二D4-D2-D0极部系数中的22个，所得GV数据在次数32以内完备。
3. 这些数据可生成PT与DT表，但亏格84、85的外推及其余极部系数仍属条件性候选，后者还依赖秩二拟模性。

title: Resurgence and Modularity in the First Painlevé Equation
abstract: For the first Painlevé equation, we relate three nonlinear Stokes maps associated with a full turn around infinity to modular transformations of the two-parameter tau function through the identity $\boldsymbol S_\pi\circ\boldsymbol S_0\circ \boldsymbol S_{-\pi}=\mathsf S\circ\mathsf T$. Here the subscripts label Borel directions, while $\mathsf S$ and $\mathsf T$ denote the modular generators. Working under the analytic assumptions of the topological recursion and exact WKB constructions, we compare Stokes multipliers of the associated isomonodromy system while tracking the homology basis of its elliptic spectral curve under rotations of the independent variable. For the sectors considered, we identify the known parameter transformation induced by an $8\pi/5$ rotation with the modular $T$-action and derive a new explicit parameter relation realizing the $S$-action for a $2\pi/5$ rotation. We also determine the multiplicative factors in the corresponding tau-function relations, including their normalization constants. Together, these results give an explicit realization of single-valuedness after one full turn around infinity for both the Painlevé transcendent and its tau function, with the tau-function prefactors cancelling by Abel's five-term identity for the Rogers dilogarithm.
summary:
1. 作者研究第一Painlevé方程的Stokes跃迁与模变换的联系，在拓扑递归及精确WKB的解析假设下，比较等单值系统的Stokes乘子并追踪椭圆谱曲线的同调基。
2. 结果将8π/5旋转对应于模T作用，导出2π/5旋转实现模S作用的新参数关系，并确定tau函数乘性因子及归一化常数。
3. 这些关系在所考察扇区内显式实现绕无穷远一周后的单值性，tau函数前因子由Rogers双对数五项恒等式抵消，但尚依赖上述解析假设。

title: The Non-Relativistic Limit of Five-Dimensional Boson Stars and Scale Invariance Violation
abstract: We investigate the non-relativistic limit of spherically symmetric boson stars in (4+1)-dimensional general relativity (GR). In this limit, the resulting Newtonian theory exhibits an exact scale invariance, leading to a critical boson star configuration with a fixed global U(1) charge and vanishing binding energy. We identify the origin of these properties in the restored scale symmetry and analyze how relativistic and gravitational corrections break this symmetry. By comparing the full (4+1)-dimensional Einstein-Klein-Gordon system with the Wick-Cutkosky model, we quantify the effects of these corrections on the energy-charge relation and the kinematic stability of the configurations. Our results demonstrate how weak violation of scale invariance lifts the degeneracy of the non-relativistic solutions and determines the behavior of boson stars away from the critical limit.
summary:
1. 作者研究四加一维球对称玻色子星的非相对论极限，通过比较完整爱因斯坦–克莱因–戈登系统与威克–库特科斯基模型，分析尺度对称性及其修正。
2. 牛顿极限的精确尺度不变性使临界构型具有固定全局U(1)荷与零束缚能，而相对论和引力修正弱破坏该对称性，解除解的简并并改变能量–荷关系及运动学稳定性。
3. 结果为理解偏离临界极限的玻色子星提供了对称性机制，但运动学稳定性分析尚不能确立完整的动力学稳定性。

title: Conformal Spectrum of (Super) Chiral Ising and XY Models
abstract: We determine the spectrum of scaling dimensions of composite operators in the critical Gross-Neveu-Yukawa and Nambu-Jona-Lasinio-Yukawa models through a next-to-leading order semiclassical computation. Their infrared fixed points belong to the chiral Ising and chiral XY universality classes, respectively. At next-to-leading order, we resolve the Lorentz structure of the operator spectrum. For the parameter values at which supersymmetry is expected to emerge in the infrared, we obtain a closed-form expression encoding the full spectrum within the semiclassical methodology. The resulting organization of operators into superconformal multiplets provides further evidence for emergent superconformal dynamics.
summary:
1. 作者针对手征伊辛与手征XY普适类的临界复合算符谱，在Gross-Neveu-Yukawa和Nambu-Jona-Lasinio-Yukawa模型中以次领阶半经典计算求得标度维数。
2. 计算分辨了算符谱的洛伦兹结构，并在预期红外涌现超对称的参数处，得到编码半经典框架内完整谱的闭式表达。
3. 算符组织成超共形多重态，为涌现超共形动力学提供进一步证据，但结论受限于半经典方法，尚非非微扰证明。

title: Bootstrapping Wilson lines in Critical Bosonic QED$_3$ Part 1: Large-$N$ endpoint correlators and CFT data
abstract: We study the conformal Wilson line with general charge $q$ in critical bosonic QED$_3$ with $N$ complex scalar flavors by combining diagrammatic four-point calculations with endpoint crossing. We formulate the endpoint crossing equations with the full $\mathrm{SU}(N)$ flavor structure, keeping positivity manifest. For arbitrary positive integer charge $q$ held fixed at large $N$, we obtain closed-form expressions for four-endpoint correlators and mixed correlators involving two bulk Hubbard--Stratonovich fields through first subleading order in $1/N$. These results determine the endpoint dimension, the defect $g$-function, and the dimensions and endpoint OPE coefficients of the lowest non-singlet Wilson-line primaries. Moreover, combining the diagrammatic correlator with endpoint crossing, somewhat surprisingly, we find agreement between the bulk and Wilson-line spectra in every non-singlet flavor channel through order $1/N$. At degenerate levels, this agreement concerns the OPE-weighted averages of anomalous dimensions probed by the endpoint correlator. For unit charge, we independently reproduce these averages from the known bulk higher-spin spectrum.
summary:
1. 作者结合图解四点计算与保留完整SU(N)味结构及正性的端点交叉方程，研究临界玻色QED₃中固定正整数电荷Wilson线的大N端点关联与缺陷共形数据。
2. 计算得到至1/N阶的端点及混合关联闭式解，并发现所有非单态味道通道的体谱与线谱相符，但简并能级仅指OPE加权反常维数平均值。
3. 这些结果为Wilson线自举提供了解析输入，但谱的一致性尚限于所算阶次与端点关联可探测的数据，不能据此断言逐态或全阶等价。

title: Topological interfaces between universes and generalized families of 2d QFTs
abstract: Two-dimensional quantum field theories with topological point operators decompose into universes. Just as fusion categories have played an important role in understanding non-invertible symmetries, multi-fusion categories play an analogous role for the symmetries of such decomposing theories. We describe a finite symmetry as a multi-fusion category together with its action functor, which keeps track of trivially acting symmetries and of the topological interfaces between universes. Relative to a chosen symmetry, we classify pairs of universes by the topological interfaces it contains, which reflect the structure of the multi-fusion category: universes in different indecomposable summands are joined by no interface (Type~III), while within a summand they are related by invertible (Type~I) or only non-invertible (Type~II) interfaces. For orbifolds with a trivially acting abelian normal subgroup, we derive the full inherited symmetry, which characterizes the operators between universes found case by case by Robbins, Sharpe and Vandermeulen and yields pairs of Types~I and~II but never of Type~III. We construct Type~III pairs instead from extensions of $2$-group type and from renormalization group flows out of a common ultraviolet theory. Finally, we propose a correspondence with the generalized families of quantum field theories of Brennan and Intriligator, in which equivariant families correspond to Type~I pairs and categorical ones to Type~II pairs whose gauging preserves the symmetry, family anomalies appear as universes carrying different symmetry-protected topological phases, and Type~III pairs can realize families over a discrete parameter. An appendix by Xingyang Yu works out the higher-charge Schwinger model as a Lagrangian example.
summary:
1. 针对含拓扑点算符的二维量子场论如何分解为宇宙及其对称性，作者以多融合范畴和作用函子刻画有限对称性，追踪平凡作用与宇宙间拓扑界面。
2. 相对于选定对称性，宇宙对按可逆、仅不可逆或无界面分为三类；作者推导一类轨形的完整继承对称性，并以二群型扩张和重整化群流构造第三类。
3. 作者提出这些界面类型与广义量子场论族的对应，为统一描述等变族、范畴族及族反常提供框架，但该对应尚属提议。
