abstract: We prove that the three-dimensional chiral $\Z_p$ Clifford quantum cellular automata of Haah and of Sun--Yang--Wang--Tantivasadakarn--Chen are, for every odd prime $p$, not finite-depth quantum circuits, even after tensoring with arbitrary ancillary degrees of freedom and composing with translations. Previously such statements were known only inside the Clifford category. As a consequence, the group of three-dimensional QCA modulo stabilized circuits and translations is not finitely generated. The key ingredient is a new invariant of invertible subalgebras, which we conjecture to be the square of the total quantum dimension of the hosted anyon theory, modulo rational squares.
summary:
1. 针对三维手性量子元胞自动机能否由有限深度量子线路实现的问题，作者构造可逆子代数的新不变量，研究两类既有的手性ℤₚ克利福德自动机。
2. 对任意奇素数p，证明即使加入任意辅助自由度并复合平移，这些自动机仍非有限深度线路，将既有结论推广至非克利福德线路，并推出相应商群非有限生成。
3. 新不变量可能联系线路障碍与任意子拓扑序，但其等于所承载任意子理论总量子维数平方、模去有理数平方因子的解释仍是猜想。

title: Bulk gap stability and spectral flow for fermions with weak long-range interactions
abstract: We prove that weak long-range many-body interactions preserve the bulk gap of a free fermion system and that a quasi-local spectral flow transports the free ground state to ground states of the interacting system. Let $\Phi_h$ be a free fermionic interaction, possibly including pairing terms, whose infinite-volume Majorana coefficient operator $h$ has no spectrum in $(-g,g)$, and let $\mathcal V$ be an even self-adjoint many-body interaction. For sufficiently small $|\lambda|$, we construct pure ground states $\omega_{\lambda}$ of the interacting bulk system $\Phi_{\lambda}=\Phi_h+\lambda\mathcal V$ and quasi-local automorphisms $\beta_{0,\lambda}$ such that $\omega_{\lambda}=\omega_0\circ\beta_{0,\lambda}$, where $\omega_0$ is the free ground state of $\Phi_h$. Each $\omega_\lambda$ has a GNS Hamiltonian with gap at least $g-C_*|\lambda| \|\mathcal V\|_*$, where $\|\cdot\|_*$ is the relevant interaction norm. Our result allows polynomial decay of both the free coefficients and the many-body interaction. For two-site interactions on a uniformly discrete point set $\Gamma\subset\mathbb{R}^d$, a sufficient condition is decay as $(1+|x-y|)^{-\varpi}$ with $\varpi>2d$, for both the hopping and pairing coefficients and the interaction terms. The spectral-flow generator preserves the spatial exponent of the polynomial interaction norm, and its automorphisms satisfy locality bounds at that exponent. If $h$ and $\mathcal V$ have stretched-exponential decay, so does the spectral-flow generator. The proof constructs the spectral flow and establishes the gap through an excitation-number comparison, using polynomial propagation bounds for evolved interactions proved in a companion paper.
summary:
1. 针对弱长程相互作用下费米体能隙的稳定性，作者以激发数比较和准局域谱流，证明含配对项的自由系统可延拓为相互作用纯基态。
2. 所得能隙下界为g−C_*|λ|‖𝒱‖_*，谱流生成元保持多项式衰减指数；对d维两点相互作用，跃迁、配对及相互作用的衰减指数均大于2d即为充分条件。
3. 结果为弱长程相互作用下基态的准局域连续联系提供严格依据，但限于足够小的耦合，不能据此推断强耦合区的能隙稳定性。

title: Symmetries and exact solutions of stochastic differential equations: the CIR model
abstract: It is well known that in the celebrated Cox-Ingersoll-Ross process for interest rates there exists a critical relation among the model parameters. In the present work, we explain this critical relation by studying the symmetries of the stochastic differential equation and compute the solution of the model using this symmetry. In this way we also recover results of a recent paper where this property has been studied within a broader context by analyzing the relationships among the symmetries of stochastic differential equations and their corresponding forward Kolmogorov equations.
summary:
1. 针对Cox–Ingersoll–Ross利率随机过程中的临界参数关系，作者研究其随机微分方程的对称性，并利用该对称性求解模型。
2. 对称性分析解释了已知临界关系并给出模型解，同时重现了近期从随机微分方程及其前向柯尔莫哥洛夫方程的对称性联系出发所得的相关结果。
3. 这项工作为理解该模型的特殊可解性提供了对称性视角，但摘要未说明解的适用参数范围，也未展示向其他随机过程的推广。

title: Local determination of low-energy states in gapped fermion systems with weak long-range interactions
abstract: We consider bulk-gapped fermion systems whose infinite-volume bulk is obtained by adding sufficiently weak even many-body interactions to a free Hamiltonian with spectral gap $g>0$, allowing polynomial spatial decay of both parts. We prove quantitative local determination of low-energy states: whenever another interaction agrees with the bulk interaction inside a finite or infinite region $U$, with bulk terms crossing its boundary unchanged or removed, all its states with excitation energies in $[0,3g/4]$ have local expectations close to those of the bulk ground state deep inside $U$. The error decays with the distance to the complement of $U$, independently of the interaction terms supported outside $U$ and of the chosen low-energy state. Quantitative local determination has strong consequences. (i) The bulk interaction has a unique algebraic ground state. (ii) A strong "local perturbations perturb locally" (LPPL) principle holds: arbitrary distant defects change local ground-state expectations only by a spatially decaying error. (iii) Low-energy excitations in finite samples remain localized near the boundary for all times, up to spatially decaying tails, uniformly over arbitrary even boundary terms. (iv) Correlations from deep inside $U$ to outside $U$ are small, with quantitative bounds in terms of spatial separation and distance to $U^c$. To prove local determination of low-energy states, we combine quasi-adiabatic transport of the free ground state to the interacting bulk ground state with a new condition, local excitation detectability (LED). A companion paper establishes gap stability and constructs the transport for weak interactions, while we prove LED at sufficiently weak coupling. The abstract theorem is nonperturbative and applies whenever the transport and LED hypotheses hold.
summary:
1. 针对具有多项式衰减弱相互作用的有隙费米系统，作者结合准绝热输运与新提出的局域激发可探测性条件，证明低能态由局域体相相互作用定量决定。
2. 激发能不超过3g/4的态在区域深处趋近体相基态，误差随距边界距离衰减且不依赖外部相互作用，并推出体相基态唯一及有限样品低能激发始终局限于边界附近。
3. 该结果为远处缺陷的局域影响提供严格界限，抽象定理也可用于非微扰情形，但须先验证输运与局域激发可探测性条件。

title: Twinor Theory: Field Equations from $(A)dS_4^{\mathbb C}$ Spin-Tractors: A Twin to Twistor Theory Modelled on $(A)dS_4^{\mathbb C}$
abstract: Twinor theory is formulated as a spacetime-based counterpart to twistor theory using holomorphic reductive Cartan geometry modelled on complexified $(A)dS_4$. The fundamental spin-tractor bundle defines Dirac twinors, its symmetric powers define ladder twinors, and their extremal Lorentz components define chiral twinors. The general \textit{twinor field equation} is $D\mathbf Y=\mathbf J$. Its adjacent contractions and mixed divergence are constrained by source relations; no additional equation is imposed on its completely symmetric projection. On a flat torsion-free Lorentzian background, the adjacent equations with the mass-normalization source and vanishing additional contracted sources, together with vanishing mixed divergence, reproduce the massive \textit{Dirac--Fierz--Pauli system}; the massless chiral realization gives the zero-rest-mass equations. Within the fixed mass normalization, the reality condition yielding a positive real mass squared is the \textit{anti-de Sitter reality condition} on the particle scale, independently of the cosmological scale and background curvature. The mass-coupling phase is therefore present in the classical connection before quantization. Nonlinear gravity is formulated through the full adjoint curvature, with energy--momentum and spin currents specifying Einstein--Cartan dynamics without requiring an action. The adjoint Bianchi identity constrains source compatibility, while a BGG-type sequence organizes torsion-free infinitesimal deformations. Matter interactions enter through the coupled connection and contracted source relations, with curvature compatibility recorded by $D\mathbf J=\mathcal F_D\mathbf Y$. Both chiralities are retained, and the additional consistency requirements for interacting higher-spin fields are distinguished from the underlying bundle construction.
summary:
1. 作者以复化（反）德西特空间为模型，借助全纯嘉当几何与旋量拖拉机丛构建孪旋量理论，研究统一物质场方程及其引力耦合。
2. 在平直无挠背景及指定源约束下，该框架恢复有质量狄拉克–菲尔兹–泡利系统和无质量手征方程，并在固定质量归一化下将正实质量平方联系于粒子尺度的反德西特实条件。
3. 伴随曲率与比安基恒等式提供无须作用量的爱因斯坦–嘉当动力学及源相容性框架，但相互作用高自旋场仍需满足额外一致性条件。

title: Entropic Fluctuations in Quantum Statistical Mechanics: A Review
abstract: The celebrated Evans--Searles, respectively Gallavotti--Cohen, fluctuation theorem concerns certain universal statistical features of the entropy production rate of a classical system in a transient, respectively steady, state. In this paper, we review and compare several possible extensions of these fluctuation theorems to quantum systems. We present, in an introductory way, the approach proposed in a recent series of works [Lett. Math. Phys. 114, 32 (2024): doi: https://doi.org/10.1007/s11005-024-01777-0 ], [Rev. Math. Phys 38, 2461006 (2026): doi: https://doi.org/10.1142/S0129055X24610063 ], [Commun. Math. Phys. 406, 201 (2025): https://doi.org/10.1007/s00220-025-05360-z ] and [J. Math. Phys. 67, 022101 (2026): doi: https://doi.org/10.1063/5.0311182 ] including a previously missing extension of the Gallavotti--Cohen (steady state) version of the FT to two-time measurement entropy production in the algebraic setting of quantum dynamical systems. We focus on the open quantum systems, where a small system interacts with several (infinitely extended) reservoirs, and discuss the following approaches: naive, two-time measurement, phase space contraction and ancilla state tomography. We review the connection with modular theory. The latter provides a way to extend the classical notions to the quantum domain. We discuss the quantum version of the principle of regular entropic fluctuations, introduced in the classical context in [Nonlinearity 24, 699 (2011): doi: https://doi.org/10.1088/0951-7715/24/3/003 ]. Finally, we relate the statistical properties of these various notions of entropy production to spectral resonances of quantum transfer operators and apply this approach to a paradigmatic model of non-equilibrium statistical mechanics: the spin-fermion model. The results presented here shed a new light on the nature of entropic fluctuations in quantum statistical mechanics.
summary:
1. 针对经典熵产生涨落定理如何推广至量子系统，作者综述并比较小系统耦合多个无限热库时的熵产生定义，以模理论和量子转移算符谱共振为工具。
2. 综述重点介绍代数量子动力学框架中双时测量熵产生的稳态涨落定理扩展，补足此前缺失的版本，并将相关方法用于自旋—费米子模型。
3. 这些联系为比较不同量子熵产生定义及其统计性质提供理论路径，但摘要未给出普遍适用条件或实验验证，推广至其他模型仍需具体检验。

title: Defining 2-group symmetries on lattices and extracting their anomalies
abstract: Ordinary $0$-form symmetries $G$ can mix with $1$-form symmetries $\Pi_2$ to form a $2$-group $\mathcal{G}$. We give a concrete lattice definition for a class of finite $2$-group symmetries in terms of local relations among symmetry operators. These relations identify the Postnikov class $[\rho]\in H^3(BG,\Pi_2)$ that characterizes the mixing. We develop a method to extract anomalies of these symmetries in one spatial dimension by restricting symmetry operations to an interval and comparing their composition near its endpoints. We also construct explicit qubit symmetry actions in $d=1,2,3$ spatial dimensions for a $2$-group with $G=\Pi_2=\mathbb{Z}_2$. These actions share the same nontrivial Postnikov class but include both anomaly-free and anomalous realizations. Their cohomological anomalies are classified by $H^{d+2}(B\mathcal G,U(1))$, which is $\mathbb{Z}_2$ for $d=1,2$ and $\mathbb{Z}_2\times\mathbb{Z}_2$ for $d=3$, and our constructions realize every class in these dimensions. Our results connect higher-group symmetry and its anomalies to concrete lattice operations, providing a microscopic framework for studying anomalous symmetries.
summary:
1. 针对零形式与一形式对称性如何在晶格上混合，作者以局域算符关系定义一类有限二群对称性、识别其Postnikov类，并通过区间端点处的操作复合提取一维反常。
2. 对两种对称群均为ℤ₂的情形，量子比特构造在一至三维实现全部上同调反常类，且表明同一非平凡Postnikov类可兼容无反常及有反常实现。
3. 这些构造为高阶群反常提供微观研究框架，但端点提取方法仅在一维建立，向更高维推广仍待研究。

title: Magic in Grover's Algorithm and the Role of Oracle Synthesis
abstract: Grover's algorithm is a textbook example of quantum advantage, providing a quadratic query speedup over classical methods for unstructured search. In this Letter, we characterize the non-stabilizerness, or magic, developed throughout Grover's protocol, quantifying quantum complexity with respect to the efficiently simulable stabilizer states. First, we compute the compilation-independent magic at the end of each Grover iteration, deriving an analytic prediction for the stabilizer Rényi entropy and proving that it remains intensive as the system size grows. We then investigate the magic overhead due to decomposing the circuit into elementary gates. When the solution to the search problem is known, we show that an efficient decomposition exists that keeps magic bounded despite using an extensive number of Toffoli gates. In contrast, agnostic implementations are expected to generate volume-law non-stabilizerness, as we confirm for the 3-SAT problem, which rules out efficient simulation by stabilizer-based methods in practically relevant cases. Our findings clarify the growth of magic in Grover's algorithm and the role of solution-awareness in its circuit compilation.
summary:
1. 作者研究Grover搜索中非稳定子资源的增长，解析推导每轮迭代末的稳定子Rényi熵，并比较不同预言机门分解引入的额外资源。
2. 迭代末的魔性不随系统规模广延增长，已知解时即使用广延数量的Toffoli门也可保持有界；不知解时预期出现体积律，3-SAT实例支持此预期并排除稳定子方法的高效模拟。
3. 结果表明，解信息与预言机编译会影响魔性开销，但不知解时的体积律尚非普遍定理，也不能据此排除其他经典模拟方法。

title: Topological Quantum Error-Correcting Thresholds of a Symmetry-Enriched Toric Code
abstract: We study the error thresholds of a new topological quantum error-correcting code under the independent bit-flip and phase-flip noisy channel. By mapping to classical spin-glass models, we find that if Pauli X and Z errors are equally probable, the threshold of vertex syndromes is improved by 30% compared to that of the toric code, while the threshold of plaquette syndromes is lowered. Both thresholds increase when the Z component is less likely than the X component, reaching 0.5 if the Z component is absent. An analytical proof justifies this special case of perfect correctability, and a disordered version of Peierls's argument establishes a lower bound for the vertex-syndrome threshold.
summary:
1. 作者研究对称性丰富环面码在独立比特翻转与相位翻转噪声下的纠错阈值，将问题映射为经典自旋玻璃模型。
2. 当X与Z错误等概率时，顶点综合征阈值较环面码提高30%，但面综合征阈值降低；减小Z错误概率可提升两者，无Z错误时均达0.5。
3. 无Z错误极限的可纠正性获解析证明，无序Peierls论证还给出顶点阈值下界，表明噪声偏置可能有利于该码，但阈值优势并非对所有综合征普遍成立。

title: Lower Bound for Region of Non-Distillable Magic States
abstract: Magic states are a leading proposal for realizing fault-tolerant and universal quantum computation. At the present moment, much of the theory of magic states is not understood. Even simple questions such as what single qubit states have magic remain open. In Campbell and Browne's seminal paper on bound magic states, they prove the existence of states outside of the stabilizer octahedron which cannot be used to achieve universal computation. In this paper we expand upon their proof and determine a lower-bound on this region.
summary:
1. 针对单量子比特态中不可蒸馏魔态的分布问题，作者扩展坎贝尔与布朗关于束缚魔态存在性的证明，研究稳定子八面体之外的不可蒸馏区域。
2. 工作从证明此类态存在推进到确定该区域的下界，为刻画非稳定子态与可用于通用量子计算的资源之间的差别提供更具体的约束。
3. 这一下界可为厘清魔态蒸馏的资源边界提供依据，但摘要未给出下界的具体形式，也未表明已确定不可蒸馏区域的完整边界。

title: Stellar Representation of Gottesman Kitaev Preskill States on the Double Discrete Cylinder
abstract: Covariant integral quantization is developed on the double discrete cylinder phase space, with the torus as configuration space, and yields the Wigner distribution and the stellar representation. This phase space is particularly well suited to translationally invariant states, such as the Gottesman Kitaev Preskill (GKP) states. These states are central to fault-tolerant quantum computing architectures, yet their quantum resources are still under investigation. The stellar representations of ideal GKP logical states, which behave as phase eigenstates of the double discrete cylinder, have no zeros on this phase space, whereas those of their superpositions have infinitely many. The vacuum, although Gaussian, has zeros on this phase space, and the zeros of finitely squeezed GKP states move with the widths of the peaks and of the envelope, and reach this phase space for fine-tuned widths. These features echo the role of the vacuum as the resource that makes GKP-based architectures hard to simulate.
summary:
1. 针对GKP态量子资源的相空间刻画，作者以环面为构型空间，在双离散柱面上建立协变积分量子化，导出维格纳分布与星表示。
2. 理想GKP逻辑态的星表示无零点，叠加态却有无穷多零点；高斯真空也有零点，有限压缩态的零点随峰宽和包络宽度移动，并在精细调节时进入该相空间。
3. 这些零点特征呼应真空在GKP架构经典模拟困难中的资源作用，但尚不足以确立零点结构与计算复杂性的定量联系。

title: Ground-state energy estimation compiled on cat qubits: 7 164 qubits for FeMoco-54 in 23.5 hours
abstract: We provide a detailed resource estimate of the state-of-the-art sum-of-squares block encoding algorithm for electronic structure Hamiltonians of Low et al. on superconducting cat qubits. To achieve this, we present compilations with closed-form costs of the dominant subroutines such as skew-tree Qrom, a Swap network and a Phaseup for both a repetition-cat and an LDPC-cat architecture. Our compilation represents algorithmic qubits in the $X$ basis, taking advantage of the asymmetric cost of $X$ and $Z$ access that the concatenation of cat qubits with phase-flip classical code brings. Additionally, we provide a protocol for $\vert i \rangle$-state distillation and a two-level Toffoli-like $\vert \text{C}_X\text{C}_X X \rangle$ magic state distillation protocol, including three factory layouts. To minimize the cost of Clifford corrections induced by magic state injections we tailor injection gadgets to each subroutine. Combining our compilation work with the adder compilation from the companion work Pappalardo et al., we provide global layouts for the block encoding in both architectures which we use to obtain resource estimates for ground-state energy estimation for the benchmarks of FeMoco-54 and FeMoco-76. Assuming a cycle time of 1$\mu$s, a reaction time of 10$\mathrm{\mu}$s, a phase estimation precision of 1 mHa and circuit-level phase-flip noise with probability $p_Z = 5 \times 10^{-4}$ with negligible bit-flip error, FeMoco-54 requires fewer than $7\,500$ cat qubits with an expected runtime of under one day for a single phase estimation run using an LDPC-cat architecture. Relaxing the bit-flip requirement to $p_X = 10^{-11}$ with an additional layer of elevator codes raises this to an estimated $13\,000$ cat qubits.
summary:
1. 针对电子结构基态能量估算，作者将平方和分块编码编译至重复码与LDPC猫量子比特架构，利用噪声偏置优化子程序并估算资源。
2. 在给定时序、相位翻转率及可忽略比特翻转的假设下，FeMoco-54单次相位估计达到1毫哈特里精度预计需不足7500个猫量子比特和一天。
3. 这些估算提示偏置噪声架构可降低量子化学资源需求，但尚非实验演示，容许比特翻转率为10⁻¹¹时需额外编码，估计增至13000个猫量子比特。

title: Twisted Fourier Analysis of Quantum Weight Enumerators
abstract: A unified Fourier framework for quantum weight enumerators of prime-power-dimensional qudits is developed in this paper. We introduce the notions of Weyl power spectrum and Weyl-conjugation autocorrelation for the Weyl-operator quantities nderlying the Shor--Laflamme weight enumerators. Representing these quantities as formal vectors, we show that they form a symplectic Fourier transform pair, from which the quantum MacWilliams identity follows by applying the Hamming-weight functional. This framework extends to a family of twisted Fourier transforms, including the Rains shadow transform. We show that identical-copy Bell sampling corresponds to a twisted autocorrelation related to the shadow enumerator through Weyl translation and Hamming projection. We further prove that all twisted Fourier transforms are Weyl translations of either the ordinary MacWilliams transform or the Rains shadow transform. This two-class reduction implies that the twists yield no additional independent coefficientwise positivity constraints under compatible projections. Nevertheless, the framework leads to refined MacWilliams and shadow identities that retain more Fourier information than ordinary Hamming weight enumerators. We employ these refined identities in linear programming, together with simplex mapping and shadow-coset counting, to exclude surviving candidate weight distributions. These techniques yield tighter bounds for binary and qutrit quantum codes, including nonexistence results for specific code parameters.
summary:
1. 针对素数幂维量子码权重枚举式的统一结构，作者以外尔功率谱和共轭自相关构造辛傅里叶变换对，并扩展至扭曲变换。
2. 证明所有扭曲变换均归约为麦克威廉斯或影子变换的外尔平移，并以保留更多傅里叶信息的精细恒等式结合线性规划，收紧二元及三元量子码界并排除特定参数。
3. 该框架可为量子码界研究提供更细约束，但在相容投影下，扭曲变换本身不增加独立的逐系数正性条件。

title: Ontology without states: PBR as an argument for dynamics-first realism
abstract: The Pusey--Barrett--Rudolph (PBR) theorem is commonly taken to establish that a pure quantum state represents a physical property of the system to which it is assigned, rather than merely encoding knowledge. In this work, I distinguish between state-first and dynamics-first physical theories, and argue that this reading presupposes the former. These two types of theories support different approaches to causal explanation, and one of PBR's stated assumptions depends on the state-first approach. Using a recent interpretation of quantum theory as a concrete example, I show how a dynamics-first theory can explain the PBR correlations while maintaining a broadly epistemic reading of quantum states. I conclude that the PBR theorem supports a dilemma: either the quantum state is part of reality, or reality is not fundamentally built out of states.
summary:
1. 作者考察PBR定理是否必然要求量子态具有实在性，通过区分状态优先与动力学优先理论的因果解释，并以一种近期量子诠释为例检验其前提。
2. 论证指出PBR的一项假设依赖状态优先框架，而动力学优先理论可在保留量子态广义认识论解读的同时解释PBR关联。
3. 这一分析将结论重述为量子态属于实在或实在并非根本由状态构成的两难，但尚不能据此确立动力学优先本体论。

title: Reducing the cost of ancilla purification for Majorana quantum computation
abstract: Braiding Majorana zero modes does not by itself provide a universal set of quantum gates. Additional operations can be supplied through ancillary states, whose preparation need not have the same protection as braiding. Here, we consider purification of the non-Gaussian ancilla used for an entangling gate in Bravyi's scheme. We keep his elementary braid-and-fusion comparison and change how its outputs are combined. An additional layer compares the product of the three stabilizer signs. The first accepted errors giving an incorrect output then require three faulty input blocks rather than two. As a result, the preparation error decreases cubically instead of quadratically, and the asymptotic raw-copy overhead is reduced. We also construct a preliminary sequence in which a processed block is paired with a fresh copy from the same noisy source. For independent inputs supported in the even-parity sector and ideal purification operations, this sequence establishes a sufficient distillability fidelity of 59.95 percent after free Gaussian twirling. At a common source fidelity, it reduces the expected cost of preparing an input for the recurrence by more than seven orders of magnitude relative to the balanced construction studied here. Finally, we examine imperfect purification operations in an effective syndrome-noise model. The additional layer leaves the leading operation-error coefficient unchanged, although a nonzero error floor remains.
summary:
1. 针对马约拉纳编织不足以实现通用量子门的问题，作者保留布拉维方案的编织与融合比较，增设稳定子符号乘积比较层并改组辅助态纯化流程。
2. 新流程使制备误差由二次降为三次抑制；在独立偶宇称输入和理想操作下，预处理给出59.95%的充分可蒸馏保真度，相同源保真度下成本较所考察平衡构造降低逾七个数量级。
3. 该方案有望降低非高斯辅助态开销，但有效噪声模型中操作误差的首阶系数未变且仍有误差底限，实际收益尚需检验。

title: Continuous variable quantum key distribution through a fading channel with minimal information leakage
abstract: Continuous variable quantum key distribution enables two parties to extract provably secure keys for cryptography by exploiting aspects of quantum mechanics. A central challenge in achieving QKD over long distances is overcoming optical loss, which limits the secret key rates and achievable transmission distances. Recent work has illustrated how to perform continuous variable quantum key distribution while eliminating information leakage to an eavesdropper in a pure-loss channel and minimizing information leakage in a noisy channel. In this work, we analyse this protocol under conditions where the quantum channel linking the sender and receiver is a fading channel, which can be used to model free-space links. We find that the protocol maintains strong performance over fading channels and outperforms comparable protocols.
summary:
1. 针对光学损耗限制连续变量量子密钥分发的问题，作者在可模拟自由空间链路的衰落信道中，分析了旨在抑制窃听信息泄漏的既有协议。
2. 分析表明，该协议在衰落条件下仍保持良好性能，并优于可比协议，将其适用范围拓展至波动信道，但摘要未给出性能增益或泄漏量。
3. 结果支持进一步评估该协议用于自由空间量子密钥分发的潜力，但尚不能据此认定已实现衰落信道中的零泄漏或实验部署。

title: Exact Positive-P Simulation of Open Quantum Spin Systems with Generalized Density Matrix Formalism
abstract: The positive-P representation for bosons allows scalable exact simulations of many-body open quantum systems, provided dissipation is strong enough to stabilise stochastic trajectories. Designing analogous methods for spin systems, relevant to quantum technologies, remains challenging, as previous spin positive-P formulations can exhibit systematic errors even when simulations are numerically stable. Here, we develop a phase-space representation that maps spin-$\frac{1}{2}$ degrees of freedom onto parameters of a local generalized density matrix (GDM), rather than SU(2) coherent states. In all stable regimes, we observe no deviations from exact solutions, restoring the positive-P property: stable solutions are exact up to stochastic sampling noise. The GDM representation combines seamlessly with bosonic positive-P, enabling highly scalable treatment of coupled spin-boson systems. We map simulation stability versus spin and boson dissipation in the Jaynes-Cummings model and apply the method to a Jaynes-Cummings-Hubbard quasi-Lieb lattice, showing how spin dissipation and driving can destroy or restore excitation incompressibility.
summary:
1. 针对开放自旋系统正P模拟虽数值稳定却可能存在系统误差的问题，作者以局域广义密度矩阵参数表征自旋二分之一，并与玻色正P表示结合。
2. 所考察稳定区间内结果与精确解一致至抽样噪声，并在杰恩斯–卡明斯模型中绘制耗散稳定性图，在准利布晶格中展示耗散与驱动可破坏或恢复激发不可压缩性。
3. 该方法为大规模开放自旋–玻色体系模拟提供路径，但精确性仍以随机轨迹稳定为前提，尚不能保证任意耗散参数下均可可靠求解。

title: Quantum advantage by designing beneficial dissipation from lossless dynamics
abstract: Passive loss removes probability from a system and therefore seems unable to improve an unconditional target. This intuition is exact for classical population dynamics under sink-only removal: passive killing obeys a finite-strength monotonicity principle even after optimization over the remaining controls. Here we show that coherent quantum dynamics can violate this classical monotonicity because coherent contributions to the final target can interfere destructively. We derive a trajectory-level criterion that determines when such a detrimental contribution is physically accessible to passive loss and accumulates into a net unconditional benefit. The criterion is encoded in a response operator constructed entirely from the lossless dynamics: its spectrum determines whether weak passive loss can help, while its principal eigenvector identifies the optimal environmental mode. Applying this criterion to vibronically assisted transfer, we identify a beneficial mode formed by coherently combining two individually detrimental local loss directions. The predicted mode remains near-optimal at finite loss, producing an \(8.73\%\) enhancement over the independently optimized lossless benchmark, compared with \(9.52\%\) under full finite-loss optimization. Our results establish how coherent quantum dynamics can evade classical passive-loss monotonicity and provide a general task-dependent principle for designing beneficial passive environments from lossless dynamics.
summary:
1. 针对被动损耗能否改善无条件目标，作者从无损相干动力学构造响应算符，以其谱及主本征矢判定弱损耗增益并设计最优环境模式。
2. 在振动辅助转移中，两个单独有害的局域损耗方向经相干组合，使目标较独立优化的无损基准提升8.73%，接近有限损耗全面优化的9.52%，突破经典被动损耗单调性。
3. 该判据为按任务设计有益被动环境提供路径，但其一般保证限于弱损耗，有限损耗下的近最优性仅在所考察模型中得到展示。

title: Noise Propagation and Effective Channels in Encrypted Quantum Cloning
abstract: We investigate noise propagation in encrypted quantum cloning by formulating the protocol in terms of effective recovery channels. For local single-qubit completely positive trace-preserving noise, a Pauli-basis expansion of the Kraus operators reveals a strong dependence on the location of the physical channel. Noise on an auxiliary signal qubit leaves the reduced recovered state unchanged, whereas noise on an auxiliary key qubit induces a Pauli-diagonal effective channel on the recovered qubit. For the core qubits, the error propagation additionally depends on the parity of the number of entangled pairs. In particular, for noise on the core key qubit with odd parity, distinct physical Pauli sectors merge into the same effective sector, converting isotropic depolarizing noise into an anisotropic recovery channel. We also relate Werner-type resource imperfections to local depolarizing noise and distinguish distributed product depolarization from genuine global depolarization. The results demonstrate that the effective recovery noise is governed not only by noise strength, but also by its physical location and by the structure of the encryption-decryption protocol.
summary:
1. 作者针对加密量子克隆中的噪声传播，以克劳斯算符的泡利基展开构造有效恢复信道，分析局域单比特噪声的位置依赖。
2. 辅助信号位噪声不改变约化恢复态，辅助密钥位噪声产生泡利对角信道；纠缠对数为奇数时，核心密钥位的各向同性退极化可转为各向异性恢复噪声。
3. 这些结果提示噪声评估须兼顾作用位置与协议结构，并区分局域乘积退极化和全局退极化，但其对实际容错性能的改善尚未得到验证。

title: Active Approach to Fast Quantum State Preparation and Reset in Atomic Arrays
abstract: Rapid preparation of a target quantum state and reset to the many-body ground state are essential for quantum information processing. Here, we investigate both processes in a waveguide-coupled emitter array in the low-excitation regime. By decomposing the effective non-Hermitian Hamiltonian into biorthogonal eigenmodes, we show that relaxation depends on the initial overlap with the more subradiant modes, providing a modal explanation of the Mpemba effect. Guided by this insight, we design a reset protocol in which a finite-duration local drive activelysuppresses the relatively slow-decaying components. For the parameters studied, this reduces the time to reach a fixed residual-excitation threshold by up to approximately 25% compared with free decay. To prepare a target Dicke state, we introduce a two-step protocol that initially leaves one emitter undriven before restoring the full drive that stabilizes the target. This local control redistributes spectral weight into the more subradiant modes, driving them closer to their target amplitudes, which reduces the preparation time by up to approximately 45% while consuming less driving energy than continuous driving. Finally, we show how directional waveguide coupling shifts collective modes toward a preferred boundary through the non-Hermitian skin effect, providing guidance for selecting the preferred site for local operations. We term this fundamental dependence of the relaxation dynamics on the system's chirality the ``non-Hermitian Skin-Mpemba effect.'' These results demonstrate how selective local control can accelerate state preparation and reset in open quantum systems.
summary:
1. 针对量子态制备与基态复位的加速问题，作者在低激发波导耦合发射体阵列中，以非厄米哈密顿量的双正交模分解指导局域驱动设计。
2. 在所考察参数下，调控亚辐射模权重使固定残余激发阈值的复位时间最多缩短约25%，使Dicke态制备时间最多缩短约45%且较持续驱动耗能更少。
3. 定向耦合通过非厄米趋肤效应改变集体模分布，可指导局域操作选址，但加速效果目前仅在低激发区间及所考察参数下得到支持。

title: Strict Frequency Bandwidths from Causal Light Cones Enable Scalable Exact Gradient Evaluation in Quantum Optimization
abstract: Dynamical locality is often regarded as a limitation of shallow quantum circuits, yet we show that it can reduce the number of circuit settings required for exact evaluation of gradients with respect to shared parameters. For layered ansatze generated by commuting local terms, strict Heisenberg light cones confine energy slices obtained by varying one shared layer parameter to finite Fourier bandwidths dictated by local causal geometry. This bandlimit recasts exact gradient evaluation as a local signal recovery problem and, when the relevant frequencies lie on a known frequency lattice, yields an exact multipoint parameter-shift rule based on the discrete sine transform. The quantum approximate optimization algorithm (QAOA) provides a canonical realization in which this mechanism is governed by the local structure of the graph. Specifically, when a cost angle is varied, the relevant geometry is encoded by the contact region in the interaction line graph. At fixed circuit depth on graphs of bounded degree, the number of distinct circuit settings required for the corresponding derivative collapses from $O(m)$ to $O(1)$. This shows that dynamical locality is not merely a constraint on correlation propagation, but also a computational resource that enables exact gradient evaluation with fewer circuit settings in quantum optimization.
summary:
1. 针对量子优化中共享参数的精确梯度求值，作者利用对易局域项生成的分层线路，将海森堡光锥限定的傅里叶带宽转化为局域信号恢复问题。
2. 已知频率格点时，离散正弦变换给出精确多点参数移位规则，使固定深度、有界度图上QAOA代价角求导所需的不同线路设置数由O(m)降至O(1)。
3. 结果表明动力学局域性可降低梯度求值的线路设置开销，但该缩减依赖局域几何与频谱条件，并不等同于总采样成本或优化性能的提升。

title: Einstein Metrics and Quantum Control on Symmetric Tensor Product Quotients
abstract: Let $M_n=(\mathrm{PU}(2)^n\rtimes S_n)\backslash\mathrm{PU}(2^n)$ be the space of projective $n$-qubit unitaries modulo local unitaries and permutations of the qubits. We prove that for all sufficiently large $n$ the manifold $M_n$ carries exactly two $\mathrm{PU}(2^n)$-invariant Einstein metrics up to scaling. Both Einstein metrics have uniformly bounded diameter after normalizing two-qubit costs, although approximating a Haar-random unitary requires exponentially many two-qubit gates. In contrast, we construct non-Einstein metrics with nonnegative Ricci curvature and exponentially growing typical control distances, and determine the sharp curvature threshold for this family.
summary:
1. 针对多量子比特控制距离与曲率的关系，作者在模去局域幺正变换及比特置换的幺正商空间上，证明不变爱因斯坦度量的分类并构造非爱因斯坦度量。
2. 当比特数充分大时，除整体缩放外恰有两种不变爱因斯坦度量，归一化两比特代价后其直径一致有界；另有非负里奇曲率度量的典型控制距离指数增长，且该族曲率阈值被精确确定。
3. 随机幺正近似所需的指数级两比特门数与有界直径形成反差，表明这些爱因斯坦度量不能直接反映门复杂度，而非爱因斯坦构造为相关控制几何提供了候选。

title: Spectral Reduction Selects the Observable Imprint of Dirac Quantum Geometry
abstract: Spectral constraints can alter the observable manifestation of quantum geometry without changing the local eigenspace. Relativistic electron vortices provide a sharp example: the spin orbit interaction redistributes spin and orbital angular momentum, yet its magnetic contribution differs between localized three-dimensional wave packets and stationary monochromatic beams. We resolve this discrepancy by showing that fixing the energy replaces ambient momentum derivatives in position-weighted current moments by shell-tangent derivatives and derive a Hermitian selection rule for first-order observables in momentum-dependent internal subspaces. Its extension-independent form applies beyond Dirac systems, including a broad class of antisymmetric first moments of scalar-charge velocity currents. For the free positive-energy Dirac doublet, the magnetic correction is an exact non-Abelian Berry-curvature contraction with a pointwise saturable quantum-metric bound. Changing the relative phase between the two $\sigma_z$ spinor components switches this correction from zero in a conserved transverse-helicity sector to a finite value in a radial coherent superposition. At fixed finite Lorentz factor, the radial response scales as $O(\theta/\gamma)$, compared with $O(\theta^2)$ for longitudinal polarization. Spectral reduction and internal coherence thus provide distinct controls of the observable imprint of quantum geometry.
summary:
1. 针对狄拉克电子涡旋波包与单色束磁响应的差异，作者以定能壳切向导数替代动量空间全导数，推导了一阶可观测量的厄米选择规则。
2. 自由正能双重态的磁修正严格等于非阿贝尔贝里曲率收缩，并受逐点可饱和的量子度规界约束；相对相位可使其从零变为有限值，径向相干态响应为O(θ/γ)，纵向极化则为O(θ²)。
3. 结果表明谱约束与内部相干性可分别调控量子几何的可观测印记，规则亦适用于一类非狄拉克电流矩，但实验实现尚待验证。

title: Fermionic Unruh effect revisited: Entanglement and correlation dynamics under symmetric transformations
abstract: A uniformly accelerated observer perceives the Minkowski vacuum as a thermal bath, so acceleration acts as a noise channel on correlations shared with an inertial partner. For a Dirac field in the standard treatment, the resulting map is a one-sided amplitude-damping channel, and entanglement and quantum discord survive at infinite acceleration. We introduce a symmetric Unruh-like map in which the vacuum and the one-particle state both exchange amplitude with the inaccessible Rindler region; for a Bell state it yields a bit-flip channel whose flip probability is the Fermi-Dirac occupation at the Unruh temperature. Using negativity, mutual information, and all six pairwise quantum discords, we find that the entanglement and discord between the inertial observer and the accessible mode vanish together at infinite acceleration, leaving only one bit of classical correlation. These results show that the fate of quantum correlations in noninertial frames depends on the structure of the Minkowski-Rindler map.
summary:
1. 为考察加速噪声下费米场关联的演化，作者构造真空与单粒子态均耦合不可达区的对称类Unruh映射，并计算负性、互信息及六种两两量子失谐。
2. 对Bell态，该映射给出翻转概率服从费米分布的比特翻转信道，使惯性方与可达模的纠缠和失谐在无限加速时同时消失，仅余一比特经典关联。
3. 结果表明量子关联的存续依赖映射结构，但尚不能据此替代标准Unruh描述，所提对称映射的物理适用性仍需检验。

title: Coherent errors, syndrome extraction and the Robustness of Magic in stabiliser codes
abstract: Coherent errors leave stabiliser-code-encoded magic states in superpositions of syndrome sectors. We ask how much magic these coherent errors add, and whether syndrome extraction depletes logical magic. Using Robustness of Magic, we show that, for a unitary error U on a correctable region which supports no stabiliser, the encoded state has the same robustness as the logical state plus one copy of the Choi state of U , in every stabiliser code encoding. Syndrome extraction removes this copy, returning the logical robustness. The removed magic is positive for every non-Clifford error: adding a non-stabiliser state to any state multiplies one plus the robustness by a (tightly- bounded) factor above one. The magic capacity of two-qubit gates Clifford-equivalent to diagonal or single-qubit gates is equal to their Choi-state robustness. We give a linear-algebraic test for when a Clifford error makes syndrome extraction measure a logical operator, and give magic lifetimes of stored single-qubit magic states under Pauli noise. Choosing the plane of the stored state extends these lifetimes about 1.5x on rotated surface codes under low code-capacity depolarising noise. We identify states and channels in odd-prime dimension for which Wigner negativity and robustness show equal lifetimes.
summary:
1. 作者以魔性鲁棒性研究稳定子码中相干误差引入的资源及综合征提取对逻辑魔性的影响，并分析泡利噪声下的存储寿命。
2. 对不支撑稳定子的可纠错区域内的幺正误差，额外魔性等价于一份误差蔡态，提取综合征可恢复逻辑鲁棒性；低码容量退极化噪声下，选择态所在平面使旋转表面码存储寿命延长约1.5倍。
3. 结果为区分误差附加魔性与逻辑资源提供判据，并提示优化存储态取向可延长寿命，但上述恢复结论依赖区域条件，寿命增益尚限于所分析噪声模型。

title: Learning Grover mixers for constrained optimization
abstract: Grover-Mixer QAOA (GM-QAOA) is a promising quantum framework for constrained combinatorial optimization. However, its practical implementation requires the efficient preparation of a uniform superposition over feasible states. In this work, we propose a two-stage variational approach. First, a parameterized quantum circuit is trained to prepare this superposition, using an entropy-based cost function that favors a uniform distribution over feasible bitstrings. The trained circuit is then embedded in GM-QAOA, where it provides both the initial state and, together with its inverse, yields the Grover mixer. The resulting method is evaluated on two representative benchmark problems: the Maximum Weight Independent Set (MWIS) problem and the Multidimensional Knapsack Problem (MKP). While the results demonstrate consistent improvements over standard QAOA for MWIS, only marginal gains are observed for MKP, with the advantage diminishing as the problem size increases. The reduced performance on MKP reflects the growing difficulty of training the variational mixer, likely due to increasingly challenging optimization landscapes. Overall, these findings highlight both the potential of variational Grover mixers and the trade-off between their performance gains and the additional resources required for their training.
summary:
1. 针对受约束优化中可行态均匀叠加难以制备的问题，作者以熵代价训练参数化量子电路，再将其及逆电路嵌入GM-QAOA，构造初态与Grover混合器。
2. 基准测试显示，该方法在最大权独立集问题上持续优于标准QAOA，但在多维背包问题上仅获微弱增益，且优势随规模增大而减弱。
3. 结果表明学习式混合器的收益依赖问题结构，扩展应用仍需降低训练开销，而背包问题的性能退化可能源于更难优化的训练景观。

title: Pulse-Informed Physical Placement for Parallel Two-Qubit Gates in Qubit Arrays
abstract: A parallel two-qubit layer can often be realized with several nonoverlapping sets of physical couplers, but isolated calibrations do not reveal how each realization performs after optimizing its own simultaneous control pulse. We formulate physical placement and pulse synthesis as a coupled decision problem for parallel controlled-$Z$ gates in heterogeneous frequency tunable transmon arrays. The proposed processor-aware structural quantum multi-domain matrix (QMDM) links static processor, edge, incidence, and task information to a dynamic candidate response block. For each candidate placement $P$, QMDM instantiates the active Hamiltonian $H_P$; quantum optimal control (QOCT) generates a placement-specific pulse, direct coupled propagation returns the projected computational subspace overlap $F_{\rm proj}$ and computational survival; and these pulse-conditioned responses are fed back to QMDM to rank and progressively promote physical placements. This placement pulse response feedback defines pulse-informed physical placement. Here, to see the performance of the proposed method on 30 held-out synthetic $3\times3$ processors, the median final $F_{\rm proj}$ is $0.993826$ for pulse-informed placement and $0.984981$ for calibration-based placement. Also, when tested under different system conditions, the proposed pulse-informed approach uses $59.1\%$ fewer candidate QOCT optimizer iterations than the exhaustive finite-budget reference. The QMDM representation and outer search are formulated for arbitrary $L$ simultaneous two-qubit gates. Here, the present global candidate ranking validation is used for $L=2$.
summary:
1. 针对并行双比特门的耦合器选择与脉冲性能相互依赖的问题，作者在异质可调频超导量子比特阵列中，以结构矩阵联结候选布局、最优控制及耦合演化，实现布局与脉冲联合优化。
2. 在30个留出合成3×3处理器上，投影计算子空间重叠中位数由校准选址的0.984981升至0.993826，另在不同系统条件测试中较穷举有限预算基准减少59.1%的候选脉冲优化迭代。
3. 该反馈框架可为并行门布局提供脉冲层面的依据，但全局候选排序仅验证了两个同时执行的门，更多并行门及真实硬件上的有效性仍待检验。

title: Quantum Gate Engineering in Superconducting NISQ Platforms: Experimental Methods and Emerging Directions
abstract: This review aims to provide researchers, experimentalists, and quantum engineers with an updated and technically grounded perspective on the implementation of quantum gates in superconducting NISQ devices. The goal is to establish a comprehensive bridge between theoretical quantum circuit synthesis and its practical, experimental implementation, focusing on superconducting quantum technologies. We systematically examine the diverse landscape of superconducting qubits and processor architectures, ranging from conventional transmons to alternative and unconventional designs, evaluating their unique design trade-offs, connectivity constraints, device physics, and materials impact. Moving from theory to actual implementation, we detail how single- and two-qubit operations are synthesized via microwave-driven and flux-activated pulses. We here present our pulse engineering, wave shaping, calibration workflows, demonstrating how to bridge the gap between abstract gate models and real-world hardware limitations in the direction of a hardware-software co-design framework. To validate these operations, we choose benchmarking methodologies with the purpose to get the more efficient metric for the specific evaluation aspect, including truth tables and quantum process tomography. Therefore, we both discuss the theoretical concepts behind the gate synthesis and show experimental implementation of most fundamental gates by proposing a practical workflow.
summary:
1. 针对超导含噪声中等规模量子器件中抽象门模型与硬件实现的衔接问题，作者综述多类量子比特架构，并梳理微波驱动和磁通激活的门合成、脉冲整形及校准方法。
2. 文章结合基本量子门的实验实现提出实用工作流，并讨论真值表与量子过程层析的评估用途，具体关联架构、连通性和材料约束，但摘要未给出门性能的定量指标。
3. 该框架可为面向硬件约束的软硬件协同设计提供参考，但其跨架构适用性及性能改进仍需定量验证。

title: Sample-Based Quantum Diagonalization for Variable Molecular Geometries
abstract: Quantum and hybrid quantum-classical algorithms have the potential to improve the accuracy and scale of quantum chemistry and impact a broad range of applications such as drug discovery and catalysis. In particular, subspace methods such as sample-based quantum diagonalization (SQD) can already tackle classically challenging systems. However, practical algorithms that go beyond the computation of electronic ground and excited states are still scarce. Here, we introduce the variable-geometry sample-based quantum diagonalization (VGSQD) algorithm, which extends SQD to variable molecular geometries by reusing quantum samples from a reference geometry at displaced ones, thus significantly reducing quantum computational cost. Using circuits of up to 124 qubits on ibm-quebec, an IBM Heron r2 quantum processor, we determine the equilibrium geometry and energy of the weakly bound, strongly correlated beryllium dimer, as well as the water molecule. Finally, we extend VGSQD to chemical reactions and compute the minimum energy path and energy barrier of a hydrogen exchange reaction. The results are comparable with state-of-the-art classical methods such as CCSD(T) and DMRG. This work broadens the scope of quantum algorithms for chemistry, from energies to geometry optimization and reaction pathways, both essential for practical applications.
summary:
1. 针对分子几何变化带来的量子采样开销，作者提出变几何采样量子对角化算法，在IBM量子处理器上复用参考构型样本以计算偏移构型。
2. 利用至多124量子比特电路，算法求得铍二聚体和水的平衡构型与能量及氢交换反应路径与能垒，结果与CCSD(T)、DMRG等方法相当，并降低量子计算成本。
3. 该演示将采样量子对角化拓展至结构优化和反应路径，但尚未给出成本降幅或证明相对经典方法的计算优势。

title: Key Evaluation of a Relativistic Quantum Key Distribution Over a Turbulent Free-space Optical Channel
abstract: We investigate the performance of relativistic quantum key distribution (RQKD) over turbulent free-space optical channels for both single-photon and coherent-state implementations. A theoretical model is developed to describe the effect of atmospheric turbulence on interferometric visibility and secret-key generation by incorporating turbulence-induced phase fluctuations into the key-rate analysis. Numerical simulations are performed under realistic channel conditions to evaluate the achievable communication distance and secret-key rate. The results show that atmospheric turbulence degrades the protocol performance by reducing interference visibility, with the severity of the degradation determined by the ratio between the interferometer-arm separation $r$ (or temporal separation of signal and reference states $\Delta T$) and Fried's parameter. The single-photon protocol remains operational over all investigated turbulence regimes, whereas the coherent-state implementation exhibits a critical dependence on the interferometer geometry (especially on $\Delta T$), leading to a threshold beyond which secure key generation is no longer possible. These findings quantify the impact of atmospheric turbulence on relativistic quantum key distribution and provide practical guidelines for the design and optimization of free-space RQKD systems.
summary:
1. 针对大气湍流如何限制自由空间相对论量子密钥分发，作者将湍流相位涨落纳入密钥率模型，数值评估单光子与相干态方案的可达距离和密钥率。
2. 模拟显示湍流通过降低干涉可见度抑制性能，单光子方案在所考察湍流范围内仍可运行，相干态方案则存在依赖干涉仪几何、尤其信号与参考态时间间隔的安全密钥生成阈值。
3. 结果可为自由空间系统的臂间距与时间间隔优化提供理论依据，但结论限于模型及所模拟条件，实际链路表现仍需实验验证。

title: Memory-Induced Limits on Entanglement Distribution
abstract: We investigate the operational limits of entanglement distribution through quantum channels reused without reinitialization. Building on an effective repeated-use channel description, we show that residual excitations left in the channel from previous uses act as a memory source that progressively suppresses coherent quantum transmission. To quantify this limitation, we derive an analytical lower bound on the quantum capacity and combine it with the Holevo-Werner semidefinite-programming upper bound. We also provide an analytical criterion to identify entanglement-breaking channels, with thresholds that depend jointly on chain length and reuse. For perfect-state-transfer chains, the resulting capacity window yields tighter estimates than previous bounds, with the relative improvement becoming substantially more pronounced closer to the entanglement-breaking threshold. Moreover, on the second use, our lower bound certifies a maximal relative timing-error tolerance across all chains with internal memory that lies just below 22.63% and is attained by the three-site chain. We further derive a fundamental relative timing-error threshold of 36.41%, above which we analytically guarantee zero unassisted quantum capacity for every chain with internal memory, independent of the number of uses. These results establish a clear benchmark model for repeated entanglement distribution, and identify timing precision, chain length, and memory accumulation as fundamental constraints on scalable quantum-network architectures.
summary:
1. 针对量子信道未重置复用时的纠缠分发极限，作者以有效重复使用模型结合容量解析下界、半定规划上界及纠缠破坏判据，研究链中残余激发的记忆效应。
2. 所得容量区间在纠缠破坏阈值附近更紧，第二次使用时三站点链获证的相对定时误差容限略低于22.63%，而误差超过36.41%时所有含内部记忆的链均被证明无辅助量子容量为零。
3. 结果为复用链的定时精度、长度与记忆积累提供基准约束，但其对更一般量子网络架构的适用性仍待验证。

title: Gravitationally Mediated Entanglement in Interferometers with Repeated Splitting
abstract: Proposals to probe the quantum nature of gravity through entanglement between spatially separated masses have attracted considerable interest. In such schemes, spatial superpositions are prepared through controlled splitting operations that produce several interferometric branches. Here we propose and analyse protocols involving repeated splitting stages, each of which doubles the number of occupied paths. We show that the density matrix after $n$ splitting stages is related to that of the $(n-1)$-splitting protocol through local parity dephasing. Two of the resulting sectors reproduce the preceding state, while the other two acquire additional gravitational phases. Removing the locally generated parts gives an exact lower bound on the change in negativity, expressed in terms of the preceding state's negative partial-transpose eigenspace. For two splitting stages, this leads to an explicit condition on three gravitational phases under which the additional split cannot reduce negativity. We also show that further splitting cannot shorten the lifetime of the generated entanglement. If the local internal system preserves the full branch label, the positional entanglement is retained upon recombination. We describe an implementation using a reusable two-level system and local memories, and compare it with a readout without a memory register. For the latter, we derive an exact condition for when an additional splitting stage improves the readout, based on a $2\times 2$ Schur complement. Numerical simulations show an advantage in positional negativity over the rates considered, with an improvement surviving the restricted readout at all decoherence rates considered at the final readout time.
summary:
1. 针对质量空间叠加中的引力介导纠缠，作者理论分析路径逐级倍增的干涉协议，以局域宇称退相干关联相邻级次的密度矩阵。
2. 研究给出负性变化的严格下界及两级分束不降低负性的相位条件，证明继续分束不缩短纠缠寿命，并在所考察退相干率下数值显示位置负性优势。
3. 可复用二能级系统与局域存储器为保留路径标签、重合后维持位置纠缠提供实现方案，但尚无实验验证，受限读出的增益仅在所考察参数与最终读出时刻得到数值支持。

title: Inferring the Number of Quantum State Transfers with Neural Networks
abstract: Repeated-use quantum state transfer (QST) goes beyond the single-use paradigm by accounting for the memory that accumulates inside the transmission channel when it is not reset between uses. Consequently, the map governing the $n^{\mathrm{th}}$ use of the channel differs from use to use and carries a signature of each previous use. We ask whether this use number can be recovered from transmission data alone, and show that it can: a simple feed-forward neural network, given as input the Bloch vectors sent and received over a single use of an XX spin-chain channel, is able to identify the use number with an accuracy exceeding 90%. Exploiting the U(1) symmetry of the channel, we find that a reduced two-component representation of the transmitted states improves the accuracy further, to about 95%. We characterise the dependence of the classifier on the size and composition of the training data, finding that the number of sampled states and of sampled timings are equally important. We also identify the data set sizes required to reach a given accuracy. Finally, we quantify the severity of the residual misclassifications with an earth-mover distance on the confusion matrix.
summary:
1. 针对未重置量子信道的记忆能否揭示使用次数，作者以XX自旋链为平台，用前馈神经网络从单次传输前后的布洛赫矢量推断次数。
2. 分类准确率超过90%，利用信道U(1)对称性的双分量表示后约达95%，表明记忆留下可辨识特征，且训练中采样态数与采样时刻数同样重要。
3. 结果为利用传输数据诊断信道使用历史提供了思路，但证据限于所研究的XX自旋链，向其他信道及实验噪声条件推广仍待验证。

title: Local Quantum Fault Tolerance Without Expansion
abstract: We study fault-tolerant quantum computation using a fixed, local error-correction rule and a geometrically simple code: the cubical $(d,d')$-Toric code with $d',d-d'\geq 2$, including the 4D Toric code. Under sufficiently weak local-stochastic Pauli noise, our construction uses noiseless, bounded-depth classical processing per physical time step. Its correction cycle acts only on the current syndrome, has constant depth, and is repeated unchanged during idle logical computation; it requires neither multiscale decoder states nor scale-dependent communication delays. Our proof treats errors and syndromes as chains in a cubical complex, combining geometric shrinking under the sweep rule with a space--time explanation-tree argument inspired by Toom's theorem. It does not rely on expansion. We establish three results: this http URL higher-dimensional sweep rule. We give a local algorithm for choosing sweep corrections on cubical $(d,d')$-Toric complexes, resolving the local-existence question of Kubica and Preskill. 2. Fault-tolerant computation. We prove a circuit-level threshold theorem for noisy sweep cycles interleaved with logical gates. In particular, the 4D Toric code admits a fixed, constant-depth syndrome-based correction cycle without a multiscale decoder or expansion-based encoding. We do not claim constant total-depth overhead. 3. Ideal decoding under local-stochastic noise. For an initial local-stochastic Pauli error of rate $p$ below threshold, $n^{d+1}$ noiseless sweep cycles recover the encoded state on a side-length-$n$ $(d,d')$-Toric code with probability at least $1-O(\operatorname{poly}(n))p^{\Omega(n)}$, extending earlier guarantees for independent errors.
summary:
1. 针对无需扩张性质的局域量子容错，作者在含四维情形的立方环面码上构造固定扫掠纠错规则，以几何收缩和时空解释树证明其性能。
2. 该方案仅依赖当前综合征，以恒定深度局域纠错证明逻辑门与噪声纠错交替运行的电路级阈值，并将理想解码保证从独立噪声推广至局域随机噪声。
3. 结果表明多尺度解码状态并非此类容错的必要条件，但依赖足够弱的局域随机泡利噪声及每步无噪声、有界深度经典处理，且不保证总深度开销为常数。

title: Individually Addressed Logical Pauli Measurements by QLDPC Surgery on a Trapped Ion Quantum Computer
abstract: Quantum low-density parity check (QLDPC) codes may lead to order-of-magnitude reductions in the qubit overhead required for fault-tolerant quantum computation. Achieving this improved overhead requires logical operations that selectively address individual logical qubits encoded within multi-qubit code blocks. Recently proposed architectures achieve this through QLDPC surgery, in which non-destructive Pauli measurements are performed using ancillary ''gadget'' systems transiently entangled with the code block, generalising lattice surgery. Here we implement QLDPC surgery on a [[10,2,3]] generalised bicycle code using Quantinuum's H2-2 trapped ion processor. A single-round surgery measurement using seven gadget qubits measures the $\bar{X}_1$ operator with a 0.72 [0.32, 1.41]% (95% credible interval) error rate and agrees with subsequent transversal measurement with 1.03 [0.60, 1.65]% error. Decoding across three rounds of syndrome extraction suppresses the gadget measurement error, reducing the error rate to below 0.26%. The syndrome after surgery confirms return to the code space and the unaddressed ''spectator'' qubit is preserved with error 0.21 [0.04, 0.67]% during the three-round measurement. We further demonstrate composition of conjugate basis gadgets by sequentially measuring $\bar{X}_1$ then $\bar{Z}_2$, reusing the gadget qubits, and obtain a 1.12 [0.60, 1.94]% error in the $\bar{Z}_2$ measurement. These results constitute a hardware validation of the generalised surgery primitive underlying Pauli-based computing for QLDPC architectures.
summary:
1. 针对多逻辑量子比特码块的选择性操作，作者在H2-2离子阱处理器的[[10,2,3]]广义自行车码上，用七个辅助量子比特实现QLDPC手术与非破坏性逻辑泡利测量。
2. 三轮综合征译码将目标测量错误率降至0.26%以下，旁观逻辑比特错误率为0.21%，并通过复用辅助比特演示了不同逻辑比特上共轭基测量的顺序组合。
3. 结果为QLDPC架构的泡利计算提供了手术原语的硬件验证，但尚未证明其在大规模容错计算中的资源优势。

title: Time-Switching Energy-Harvesting Quantum Relay-Assisted FSO Communication with Displaced Squeezed Signaling
abstract: This paper investigates a quantum relay-assisted free-space optical (FSO) communication system in which a decode-and-forward relay is powered by time-switching optical energy harvesting and forwards the decoded information using displaced squeezed signaling (DSS). To obtain a physically con sistent description of turbulence-induced loss for non-classical signaling, each hop is modeled as a pure-loss bosonic chan nel whose random transmissivity follows a truncated Gamma Gamma law, i.e., the Gamma-Gamma irradiance conditioned on the physically admissible range of a transmittance. Under this channel, coherent states remain pure, whereas squeezed states are mapped to mixed Gaussian states. Under Helstrom-optimal detection, the average error of the coherent hop is derived in exact Laplace-series form. For the DSS hop, we derive the output states, a closed-form Gaussian fidelity with rigorous two sided bounds on the Helstrom error, and prove the existence of a loss-aware optimal photon partition. Furthermore, we prove that optimized squeezing preserves both the turbulence-induced diversity order and the leading asymptotic constant of coherent relaying, so that its benefit is a finite-photon-budget effect, and that an interior throughput-optimal harvesting fraction exists. A covariance-preserving benchmark with an exact series representation yields an analytical upper bound on the achievable throughput whose absolute gap vanishes as the relay photon budget grows. Numerical results based on the exact mixed-state Helstrom error quantify the benefit of squeezing and the regime in which it is useful.
summary:
1. 针对湍流损耗下压缩信号的中继通信，作者以截断Gamma–Gamma随机透射率的纯损耗玻色信道，研究分时光能采集驱动的译码转发自由空间光链路。
2. 作者推导相干跳精确误码级数及位移压缩跳的严格误码界，证明存在损耗感知的最优光子分配，且优化压缩不改变相干中继的渐近分集阶与首项常数。
3. 压缩优势因此限于有限光子预算，数值计算刻画其适用区间，而内部最优采能比例与渐近收紧的吞吐量上界可指导资源配置，尚非实验验证。

title: Reverse Quantum Annealing for Ground-State Energy Calculation in Molecule
abstract: We present the results of our reverse quantum annealing computations of the ground-state energies of alkaline-earth monofluoride molecules. By partitioning the Dirac--Coulomb electronic Hamiltonian into sub-QUBOs and refining forward-annealing solutions through optimized reverse-annealing schedules, residual configuration errors are systematically minimized. The electronic ground-state wave functions and energies are obtained using the Quantum Annealing Eigensolver algorithm. This work provides a pathway for achieving sub-milliHartree chemical accuracy and advancing molecular electronic structure calculations in the quantum annealing paradigm.
summary:
1. 针对碱土金属单氟化物基态能量计算，作者将狄拉克—库仑电子哈密顿量分解为子QUBO，结合量子退火本征求解器与优化反向退火日程求取波函数和能量。
2. 反向退火对正向退火所得解进行细化，系统降低残余组态误差，体现了优化退火日程改善分子电子结构求解的作用。
3. 该方法为实现亚毫哈特里精度提供路径，但摘要未给出能量误差或对照数据，尚不能据此确认已达到这一精度。

title: Beyond energy bounds: comparing Schrödinger eigenstates
abstract: We derive eigenstate comparisons from ordered Schrödinger operators, extending energy bounds to overlaps, spatial distributions and nodes. For three form-ordered operators with discrete comparison ground states, suppose the upper ground-state energy lies in the lower operator's ground-state gap. Three comparison spectral values then bound all three squared ground-state overlaps and guarantee a simple discrete intermediate ground state. Related gap estimates control low-energy subspaces and individual excited-state overlaps under additional gap conditions. In one dimension and radially, a single crossing of the potential difference relative to the energy shift orders ground-state likelihood ratios and monotone observables; a nondecreasing difference suffices. The results cover asymmetric wells and shortened right Dirichlet walls, with coordinatewise comparisons for submodular reference potentials and coordinatewise nondecreasing perturbations. A two-sided Sturm argument orders corresponding internal nodes for nondecreasing potential differences, even between orthogonal one-dimensional excited states. For Yukawa ground states, Hulthén comparisons bound overlaps, radial moments and the density at the nucleus; the latter two-sided bounds hold for screening $0<\delta<2/\sqrt6$. Optimizing scaled Hulthén majorants gives a lower bound of approximately $1.13611$ for $n^2\delta_c(n,0)$, where $\delta_c(n,0)$ is the critical screening for the $n$th $s$-wave bound state. This bound is optimal within that two-parameter comparison family.
summary:
1. 针对能量界之外的本征态比较问题，作者以二次型有序的薛定谔算符、谱隙估计和斯图姆方法，建立基态重叠、空间分布及节点的比较关系。
2. 在指定谱隙条件下，三个比较谱值即可约束三对基态的重叠平方；对尤卡瓦势，优化许尔滕比较势给出临界屏蔽量下界n²δ_c(n,0)≳1.13611。
3. 这些结果为束缚态波函数提供能量之外的严格约束，但依赖算符序、谱隙或势差单调性，临界屏蔽下界的最优性也仅限于所用双参数比较族。

title: Signatures of Narrowband and Ultrashort-Pulse-Like Probing in Coherent Anti-Stokes Raman Scattering Using Twin Beams and Sum-Frequency Generation Readout
abstract: We theoretically investigate coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering (CARS) driven by bright twin beams with sum-frequency generation (SFG) readout. Expressing the SFG output in terms of quantum-field correlation functions yields multiple correlation structures with distinct properties associated with different interaction pathways on the bra and ket sides. Among them, frequency correlations between the CARS probe and SFG gating fields enable the two fields to act collectively as an effective narrowband probe, avoiding probe-induced spectral convolution. When this behavior appears on either the bra or ket side, the other retains Raman relaxation information as if probed by an ultrashort pulse.
summary:
1. 作者理论研究亮双光束驱动、和频读出的相干反斯托克斯拉曼散射，以量子场关联函数解析不同相互作用路径的探测特征。
2. 探测场与和频门控场的频率关联可形成有效窄带探针，避免探针引起的光谱卷积，且在密度矩阵一侧呈现此特征时，另一侧仍保留类超短脉冲探测的拉曼弛豫信息。
3. 该理论机制提示兼顾窄带光谱特征与弛豫动力学信息的可能性，但其可实现性及实验读出能力仍待验证。

title: Force Sensing in a Recoverable Bosonic Quantum Memory
abstract: In continuous-variable quantum information, sensing and quantum error correction in the same mode face an intrinsic trade-off: sensors must accumulate weak external displacements, whereas bosonic codes typically suppress such shifts as errors. Here, we establish compatibility by constructing finite-energy bosonic codes that enable a single oscillator to sense an external force while actively protecting an unknown logical qubit. By encoding logical amplitudes across discrete wave-packet sites and capturing the force signal in a shared internal coordinate, we achieve an endpoint probe readout that is independent of the logical state under continuous photon loss $\gamma$. Crucially, binomial site recovery cancels packet-dependent probe distortions alongside logical errors: for a $(2r+2)$-packet code, memory infidelity is suppressed to $O(\gamma^{r+1})$ while residual memory-probe correlations scale as $O(\gamma^{r+2})$. Finally, superconducting quantum circuit benchmarks under competing photon-number dephasing and Kerr nonlinearity identify preferred encoding regimes for hardware implementation.
summary:
1. 针对测力位移与玻色纠错的冲突，作者构造有限能量编码，将逻辑信息与力信号分置于波包站点及共享内部坐标，使单振子兼顾测力与未知量子比特保护。
2. 在连续光子损耗γ下，末端探针读出不依赖逻辑态，且二项式恢复使含2r+2个波包的编码将存储失真压至O(γ^{r+1})、残余存储—探针关联压至O(γ^{r+2})。
3. 超导电路基准分析在光子数退相干与克尔非线性竞争下筛选出优选编码区间，为硬件实现提供依据，但尚非实验验证。

title: A VLSI-Like Design and Verification Flow for Quantum Circuits: A Case Study in PI Estimation
abstract: This paper proposes a VLSI-like design and verification flow for quantum circuit implementation, covering four levels: behavioral modeling, register-transfer level (RTL), gate level, and full-circuit integration with quantum algorithms. Using quantum Monte Carlo methods for pi estimation as a case study, the proposed flow provides a systematic path from initial specifications to large-scale quantum circuit implementation. The paper highlights two key contributions. First, quantum digital design supports a broad range of applications beyond predefined circuit templates. This capability is particularly important for application-specific operations in algorithms such as Shor's, Grover's, and quantum amplitude estimation (QAE), and can significantly advance fault-tolerant quantum computing (FTQC). Second, classical simulation shows that replacing random sampling with grid sampling can achieve a quadratic improvement in this pi-estimation case without quantum computation. This suggests that the quadratic speedup may arise from the grid sampling strategy rather than from the QAE circuit itself. By adapting conventional VLSI digital design principles, this four-level flow addresses a key bottleneck in quantum circuit design and enables flexible design initiation from multiple entry points, including specifications, RTL, and gate-level descriptions, paving the way for the practical deployment of quantum computing.
summary:
1. 针对量子算法到电路实现的设计验证问题，作者以量子蒙特卡洛估算π为例，提出涵盖行为建模、寄存器传输级、门级及算法集成的类VLSI流程。
2. 经典模拟显示，此例中以网格替代随机采样即可获得二次改进，提示相关加速可能源于采样策略，而非量子幅度估计电路本身。
3. 该流程为定制量子运算提供多层级设计入口，但其容错计算价值仍待验证，采样结果也不能推广为对量子幅度估计优势的普遍否定。

title: NAKO: A Benchmarking Framework for Evaluating and Diagnosing Neutral-Atom Quantum Compilers
abstract: Reconfigurable neutral-atom processors couple gate scheduling, atom placement, and parallel atom transport, so compiler decisions jointly determine physical execution costs. Evaluating these compilers requires attainable resource references and a way to trace excess costs to their causes. We present NAKO, a benchmarking framework that parameterizes circuits by qubit count, logical depth, and requested one- and two-qubit gate densities, and assigns attainable targets for Rydberg stages, routing intervals, and movement layers. Each benchmark is paired with an executable reference schedule; under the stated execution model, construction guarantees minimum Rydberg-stage and routing-interval counts, and minimum movement among schedules with the minimum Rydberg-stage count. Comparing compiler outputs with these references quantifies resource gaps, while reference mappings and intermediate physical states enable controlled interventions that trace excess costs to specific compiler decisions. In a 648-run evaluation of Enola and OLSQ-DPQA, NAKO identifies distinct bottlenecks. For Enola, placement scoring and cross-stage layout management contribute to excess movement; diagnosis-guided interventions reduce mean movement by 78.9% across five matched circuits. For OLSQ-DPQA, premature candidate selection and limited exploration of preparatory states produce avoidable entangling stages and routing intervals; four fixed-checkpoint continuations each eliminate one Rydberg stage and one routing interval without increasing movement. NAKO thus links resource targets backed by constructive optimality guarantees to controlled diagnosis and validation of compiler-specific resource savings.
summary:
1. 针对中性原子编译中门调度、原子布局与输运耦合的资源开销，作者构建NAKO，以参数化电路和可执行参考调度开展基准评测与受控诊断。
2. 在648次评测中，诊断干预使Enola五个匹配电路的平均移动量降低78.9%，并使OLSQ-DPQA四次检查点续算各减少一个里德伯阶段和一个路由间隔且不增加移动。
3. 该框架可将资源差距追溯至具体编译决策，但参考调度的最优性保证限于所述执行模型，跨平台适用性仍待验证。

title: Pöschl-Teller type of Jaynes-Cummings Hamiltonians: SUSY transformations
abstract: The aim of this work is to define and investigate the generalized Jaynes-Cummings (JC) Hamiltonian by means of supersymmetric (SUSY) quantum mechanics methods. We have considered trigonometric and hyperbolic Pöschl-Teller (PT) potentials as two natural ingredients to modify the standard JC model. We show that these generalized JC Hamiltonians have a list of characteristics in common with the JC Hamiltonian, for example: matrix intertwining, excitation number symmetry, Rabi frequency, formulas for atomic inversion and classical and revival times. Therefore, we conclude that JC Hamiltonians can be considered as one example of a wider a class of generalized Hamiltonians which can be useful in broader interaction problems.
summary:
1. 作者以超对称量子力学研究如何推广标准杰恩斯–卡明斯模型，将三角型与双曲型珀施尔–特勒势引入广义哈密顿量。
2. 所得模型保留矩阵交织关系与激发数对称性，并给出拉比频率、原子反转及经典周期和复苏时间的表达式，将标准模型的关键结构扩展至两类势。
3. 结果将标准模型置于更广的相互作用哈密顿量族中，提示其可用于其他耦合问题，但摘要未展示具体应用或实验实现。

title: Optimal Linear Combination of Hamiltonian Simulation for Dissipative Dynamics
abstract: Linear combination of Hamiltonian simulation (LCHS) is an efficient method for simulating dissipative dynamics on quantum computers. The choice of the LCHS kernel controls the cost of the algorithm. We prove that the kernel family proposed by Ni and Ying~\cite{NY26} minimizes the LCHS query cost in the minimax sense. For target accuracy $\epsilon$, the minimum cost is asymptotically $\frac{2\mathrm{e}}{\pi}(\ln\frac1\epsilon-\ln\ln\frac1\epsilon+o(1))$, with optimal leading constant $\frac{2\mathrm{e}}{\pi}$. Our lower-bound proof combines weak duality with a realization lemma that approximates extremal dual functions by matrix elements of dissipative evolutions.
summary:
1. 针对量子计算机模拟耗散动力学时核函数如何决定查询成本，作者以弱对偶性及耗散演化矩阵元逼近极值对偶函数的实现引理，证明既有核族的极小极大最优性。
2. 目标精度为ε时，最小查询成本渐近为(2e/π)[ln(1/ε)−ln ln(1/ε)+o(1)]，确定最优前导常数及次阶对数修正。
3. 该结果为哈密顿量模拟线性组合方法的核选择确立了严格成本基准，但不意味着实际电路资源或其他耗散模拟框架同样最优。

title: Adiabatic training of VQAs for entanglement detection
abstract: This paper introduces a hybrid quantum framework for training Variational Quantum Algorithms (VQAs) aimed at addressing the fundamental problem of entanglement detection using adiabatic quantum computing. This problem is of foundational significance in quantum information science and has been approached through both classical and quantum methodologies. We propose an adiabatic-inspired optimization strategy for training VQAs, which combines a discretization of the parameter space with a hierarchical segmentation scheme. The optimization problem is formulated as a Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) model to leverage the capabilities of quantum annealing. Preliminary results are compared against classical neural networks and conventional VQA training techniques. The findings aim to stimulate further investigation and discussion within the scientific community regarding the efficacy and applicability of the proposed approach.
summary:
1. 针对纠缠检测中的变分量子算法训练，作者提出绝热启发的混合量子框架，通过参数空间离散化与分层分段，将优化转化为适用于量子退火的二次无约束二元优化问题。
2. 具体进展是构建上述训练方案，并将初步结果与经典神经网络及常规变分训练比较，但摘要未报告定量性能或明确优势。
3. 该方案提供了探索量子退火辅助纠缠检测的路径，其训练效率、检测精度与可扩展性仍需进一步验证。

title: Probabilistic imaginary-time evolution via compiled diagonal representations
abstract: We introduce a probabilistic imaginary-time evolution scheme based on a compiled approximate diagonal representation of the Hamiltonian. A basis transformation is optimized offline. For a fixed compiled representation, the online circuit structure and gate count per attempt are independent of the imaginary time, and the same representation can be reused across different input states and evolution times. We derive a condition for enhanced success probability. Numerical tests show reduced online cost relative to termwise Pauli-based methods at a common accuracy threshold. We also examine how approximation errors and offline preparation costs affect the overall benefit.
summary:
1. 针对虚时间演化的在线成本问题，作者离线优化基变换，利用哈密顿量的编译近似对角表示构建概率式演化方案。
2. 固定编译表示下，单次尝试的线路结构与门数不随虚时间变化，且可复用于不同输入态；数值测试显示，同等精度下在线成本低于逐项泡利方法。
3. 作者推导了成功概率提高的条件，但整体收益仍受近似误差与离线准备成本制约，跨输入态和演化时间复用编译结果可能有助于摊薄开销。

title: Detection and Inhibition of Decoherence Through Collisions: A dynamical approach
abstract: Quantum systems are intrinsically fragile and highly vulnerable to environmental noise, making the preservation of quantum states one of the fundamental challenges in realizing practical quantum technologies. We propose two noise-agnostic quantum state protection protocols based on a collisional model. The first protocol preserves quantum states of qubits without requiring complete prior knowledge of the underlying noise dynamics, and the second even protects a logical qubit under similar circumstances. These protocols provide robust protection for arbitrary single-qubit and entangled states against general noise processes. Furthermore, their capability to safeguard quantum states with an arbitrary number of qubits enhances the reliability, robustness, and scalability of emerging quantum architectures. These results establish the proposed framework as a promising approach for practical quantum information processing.
summary:
1. 针对噪声动力学先验信息不完整时的量子态保护问题，作者基于碰撞模型提出两种协议，分别保护量子比特态与逻辑量子比特。
2. 所提协议可在一般噪声过程中保护任意单比特态和纠缠态，并适用于任意数量量子比特，将保护范围从单比特扩展至多比特系统。
3. 该框架为先验信息有限的量子态保护提供了可能路径，但摘要未给出定量性能、资源开销或实验验证，实际可扩展性仍待评估。

title: Quantum Query Complexity of Tournament Solutions
abstract: A tournament solution records a set of winners from a tournament, that is, from the outcomes of all pairwise comparisons among $N$ alternatives. We study the quantum query complexity of computing tournament solutions when the outcome of each comparison has to be learned by a query. Classically, the picture is uniform: the Copeland set, the uncovered set and the top cycle all require $\Theta(N^2)$ queries, and so does finding a single vertex of maximum out-degree. We show that the quantum query complexity of the top cycle can be computed with $\tilde\Theta(N)$ queries, and a Condorcet winner can be found with $\tilde \Theta(\sqrt N)$ queries. Finding a strong king requires $\Theta(N^{3/2})$ queries, the same as finding a vertex of maximum out-degree. We also give a self-contained alternative proof of the known $\Theta(N^{3/2})$ bound for finding a vertex of maximum degree, established by Gilani, Mande, Patro, and Raja. Our lower bounds reduce counting problems to tournament problems using Ambainis's adversary method. For the top cycle, we find a Hamiltonian path and locate the prefix forming the top cycle by divide and conquer.
summary:
1. 作者研究逐次查询两两比较结果时竞赛图胜者集合的量子查询复杂度，以哈密顿路径和分治算法求顶循环，并用对手方法建立下界。
2. 顶循环仅需近线性的量子查询，优于经典的Θ(N²)，寻找康多塞胜者需近Θ(√N)，而强王与最大出度顶点均需Θ(N^{3/2})，揭示不同胜者规则的量子加速差异。
3. 这些界限为比较型选择问题提供量子资源基准，但查询优势并不等同于实际运行时间加速，硬件实现仍待研究。

title: Non-Asymptotic Bounds via the Nussbaum-Szkoła Mapping for Quantum Hypothesis Testing
abstract: Quantum hypothesis testing concerns the discrimination between quantum states. This paper introduces novel lower and upper bounds for asymmetric quantum hypothesis testing based on the Nussbaum-Szkoła mapping. Together, these bounds provide a unified recovery of both converse and achievability results across all major asymptotic regimes, including large-, moderate-, and small-deviations. Unlike existing bounds, which either rely on technically involved information-spectrum arguments or suffer from fixed prefactors and limited applicability in the non-asymptotic regime, the proposed bounds arise from a unified framework and enable, in some cases, the direct use of classical results. It is further demonstrated that these bounds provide accurate approximations to the optimal quantum error trade-off function at small blocklengths. Numerical comparisons with existing bounds, including those based on fidelity and information spectrum methods, highlight their improved tightness.
summary:
1. 针对量子态非对称判别中的错误权衡，作者利用Nussbaum–Szkoła映射构造非渐近上下界，统一处理有限样本与渐近极限。
2. 这些界统一恢复大、中、小偏差区间的逆定理与可达性结果，并在小块长数值比较中比保真度及信息谱方法的既有界更紧。
3. 该框架可在部分情形直接借用经典结果，为有限样本量子判别提供分析工具，但小块长近似的精度目前仅有数值证据。

title: Bath-state (In)dependence of Non-Markovianity Measures in Quadratic Open Systems
abstract: Open quantum system dynamics fail to fulfill the conditions of the Markov approximation when the environment and system timescales are close to each other. Such behavior of these systems can be characterized by several non-Markovianity measures, which are expected to vary with the environment parameters. In this work, we consider a fermionic quadratic open quantum system, establishing bath-state independence of the Breuer--Laine--Piilo and the Lorenzo--Plastina--Paternostro non-Markovianity measures. However, our analytical results reveal that the entanglement-based and divisibility-based Rivas--Huelga--Plenio measures, as well as the entropic Megier--Smirne--Vacchini measure, remain sensitive to the reservoir state, through both its temperature and its chemical potential. Modeling the reservoir as a free-fermionic chain, we derive an exact time-local master equation for a single fermionic site in contact with it. Our numerical results for this model confirm these findings and show that the BLP and LPP measures vanish identically only on the bound-state threshold, where the bath-sensitive measures nevertheless remain finite.
summary:
1. 针对非马尔可夫性度量是否依赖浴态，作者解析研究二次费米开放系统，并为耦合自由费米链的单格点导出精确时间局域主方程。
2. BLP与LPP度量不依赖浴态，RHP及MSV度量则受温度和化学势影响；数值显示，前两者仅在束缚态阈值处严格为零，浴态敏感度量仍有限。
3. 结果表明浴态依赖性及非马尔可夫性判据取决于所选度量，但向非二次或相互作用系统的推广仍待检验。

title: Inevitability of the Petz transpose map
abstract: Bayes' rule is central to classical statistical inference: given a prior and a stochastic model, it determines the corresponding retrodictive conditional probabilities. In quantum theory, however, the question of whether an equally general rule of retrodiction exists and, if so, whether it is uniquely determined remains nontrivial. Here we prove that a retrodiction assignment defined for all priors and channels, which takes each predicted output state back to its prior, must coincide with the Petz transpose map if it is involutive, respects sequential and parallel composition, and agrees with unitary inversion. The theorem holds for channels between finite-dimensional full matrix algebras, with the input and output spaces restricted to the supports of the corresponding reference states. In particular, affinity under probabilistic mixtures and the characteristic square-root dependence on the reference states follow from these requirements rather than being postulated. Without involutivity, the remaining requirements characterize a family of doubly rotated Petz maps. Our result thus explains why the Petz transpose map arises in seemingly different areas of quantum theory: it is the unique quantum analogue of Bayes' rule compatible with these consistency requirements.
summary:
1. 针对量子逆向推断是否具有唯一规则，作者在有限维全矩阵代数上，以一致性公理证明将预测输出态映回先验态的逆推指派必为Petz转置映射。
2. 对合性、顺序与并行复合相容性及酉逆变换一致性共同导出唯一性，且概率混合仿射性与参考态平方根依赖无需另设；去掉对合性则得到双旋转Petz映射族。
3. 该定理为Petz映射在不同量子问题中的出现提供统一解释，但结论限于参考态支撑上的有限维信道，向更广情形推广仍待研究。

title: Bounds for General $(r,δ)$-Quantum Locally Recoverable Codes
abstract: We study general $(r,\delta)$-quantum locally recoverable codes (qLRCs) without assuming purity or a stabilizer structure, and with arbitrarily overlapping recovery blocks. Using a selection lemma for multiple-erasure recovery, we establish a Singleton-like upper bound for general quantum subspaces. When $\delta=2$, this bound reduces to the general single-erasure bound of Golowich and Guruswami. An integer optimization yields an explicit remainder correction that tightens the bound by up to $\delta-2$. For pure codes, local decoupling and entropy arguments extend the parameter bound of Galindo et al., originally obtained for pure stabilizer codes constructed from Euclidean or Hermitian dual-containing classical codes, to arbitrary pure quantum subspaces. We also remove the partition assumption from several existing pure-code bounds for disjoint recovery blocks and obtain a further remainder correction by optimizing the budget. Finally, we analyze three families attaining these bounds: pure codes with overlapping recovery blocks and $d=\delta$, which exhibit both a strict improvement of the pure-code bound and simultaneous equality in the pure-code and general bounds; impure codes with disjoint recovery blocks attaining the general bound; and an existing family of pure codes with overlapping recovery blocks and $d>\delta$, which simultaneously attains all these bounds.
summary:
1. 针对恢复块可任意重叠的量子局域可恢复码，作者用多擦除选择引理建立一般量子子空间的类Singleton界，并以解耦和熵方法推广纯码界。
